fields.title: Enjigiriza Enkulu za Gareth Evans
fields.subtitle: Ekitabo kya Ochorus ekiyamba okutegeera obulamu bwe n’enjigiriza ye
fields.description: Obulagirizi obumpi era obwesigwa eri omutima gw’enjigiriza ya Gareth Evans — okukkiriza ng’omulimu gwa Katonda ogwanukulwa obuwulize, essuubi ng’okulindirira okukakafu, okubeera mu Kristo, endagaano ey’omu kisenge ekya waggulu, okuwonyezebwa nga tuyita mu kusonyiwa n’okusumulula, buli mukkiriza okusumululwa abuuke, n’okwegomba okubeerawo kwa Katonda okweyoleka. Essuula kkumi na nnya ennyimpi, buli emu ng’ekomekkerezebwa n’ebibuuzo n’essaala, ezaawandiikibwa Ochorus ng’ekitabo ekyetongodde ekiwerekera obuweereza bwa Gareth Evans, nga kyogera amannya g’ebitabo bye omusomi abyesomere yekka.
fields.about_html:
Kino kitabo ekiwerekera Gareth Evans, so si kitabo kye yawandiika. Kyawandiikibwa Ochorus, era mu ssuula kkumi na nnya ennyimpi kinnyonnyola enjigiriza y’omusomesa wa fizikisi ow’e Wales eyafuuka omusumba, omusumba w’oku kyombo era omusomesa wa Bayibuli atambula, nga mulimu essuula ku bulamu bwe, ekifundikwa n’obulagirizi ku bitabo bye. Akawuzi kaakyo akamu kwe kukakasa kwe nti mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo Katonda y’asooka okukola, era omukkiriza ky’alina okukola kwe kukwata omukono gwe n’atambula naye, era kipima mu bukkakkamu ebifo ebitono omusomi omutegeevu w’ayinza okwagala okumusomamu n’obwegendereza.

Kikulu okutegeera obulungi ekitabo kino kye kiri ne kye kitali. Mulimu ogwetongodde ogw’okunnyonnyola, okufunza n’okusiima. Tekyawandiikibwa, tekyekenneenyezebwa era tekyakkirizibwa Gareth Evans, era tekyafulumizibwa, tekikwatagana era tekyakkirizibwa kibiina kyonna ekirina obwannannyini ku biwandiiko bye. Byonna ebinnyonnyola enjigiriza ye bifunze by’omuwandiisi w’ekitabo kino ye kennyini; ebitabo bye n’obuweereza bwe obw’okwogera byogerwako amannya gokka olw’okweyongera okuyiga kw’omusomi, era abasomi bakubirizibwa n’omutima gwonna okusoma ebitabo ebyo bo bennyini. Tewali kiwandiiko kya Gareth Evans yennyini ekizzeemu wano — wabula Ebyawandiikibwa byokka, ebijulizibwa mu kitabo kino eky’Oluganda okuva mu Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (ekitabo eky’Olungereza kijuliza Authorised Version eya King James), n’ebyo Ochorus by’ennyonnyola ku ky’ayigiriza.

Ebitabo bye ebitaano bya bwannannyini bwe yennyini era biweebwa bwereere mu tterekero ly’ebitabo erya Ochorus ng’akkirizza, era obubaka bwe kkumi na bumu, obwawandiikibwa okuva mu maloboozi ge agaakwatibwa, nabwo bulabikira eyo ng’akkirizza. Eyo y’ekifo ekisinga obulungi okumusisinkanira.

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
Mukama bw’asanyukira ekkubo ly’omuntu, aluŋŋamya entambula ye. Ne bw’aneesittalanga, taagwenga wansi, kubanga omukono gwa Mukama gumuwanirira. ZABBULI 37:23–24

Abasomesa abasinga obungi mu lunyiriri luno lw’ebitabo baali ba mirembe egyayita. Ebitabo byabwe byawandiikibwa dda, empaka ezaali zibeetoolodde zaggwaawo, era ekkanisa ebaddeko n’ebbanga okusalawo ky’ebalowoozaako. Gareth Evans wa njawulo. Yazaalibwa mu biwonvu eby’ebirombe by’amanda ag’amayinja mu bukiikaddyo bwa Wales mu 1938, akyali mulamu ng’ekitabo kino kiwandiikibwa, era ku myaka abasajja abasinga obungi gye baba baawummula dda, akyasabira ekibuga kye, akyaluŋŋamya abakkiriza abato, era, nga bw’ayogera yennyini, akyatambula mu nguudo za Victoria n’abantu ekkanisa ezisinga obungi be zandibadde tezimanyi ngeri ya kwaniriza. Musomesa wa fizikisi eyafuuka omusumba nga tasomangako wadde olunaku lumu mu ttendekero ly’eby’eddiini, eyaweereza ng’omusumba ku kyombo ku lubalama lwa Afirika ey’Ebugwanjuba, era omusomesa wa Bayibuli atambudde mu ssemazinga ttaano. Awandiise ebitabo bitaano, byonna biweebwa bwereere mu tterekero ly’ebitabo erya Ochorus ng’akkirizza, era n’obubaka bwe obumu busobola okuwulirwa n’okusomebwa eyo.

Lwaki tuwandiika ekitabo eky’engeri eno ku muntu akyali omulamu? Kubanga ebitabo bye bisomebwa abantu abatalimusisinkana n’akatono, mu nnimi z’atayogera. Basaanidde okufuna obulagirizi obumpi era obw’amazima ku ky’ayigiriza ddala, gye kiva mu Byawandiikibwa, n’awo omusomi omutegeevu w’ayinza okukipima n’obwegendereza.

Akawuzi kamu akayita mu byonna

Soma ebitabo bye ebitaano n’obubaka bwe ng’obigeraageranya, ojja kulaba ekirowoozo kimu ekinywevu nga kiddamu okulabika buli kaseera. Kye kino: mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo Katonda y’asooka okukola, era omukkiriza ky’alina okukola kwe kukwata omukono gwe n’amugoberera.

Evans ekirowoozo ekyo akikozesa kumpi ku buli kintu. Okukkiriza, bw’akakkatira, si kintu kye tweyubulira ffekka nga tufuba okukkiriza ennyo; gwe mulimu gwa Katonda yennyini mu mutima, ogwanukulwa obuwulize bwaffe. Ebibala eby’omwoyo tebiva mu kwekaka, ng’omuti bwe gutasinda kuzaala bibala byagwo; bikula nga tubeera mu Kristo. Okuluŋŋamizibwa si pulaani ekwekeddwa gye tulina okuzuula nga tweraliikirira; ye Kitaffe akulembera omwana we ddaala ku ddaala, ng’aggulawo era ng’aggalawo enzigi mu kkubo. Obuweereza si mulimu omusumba gw’agabira abalala; gwe mugugu Katonda gw’ateeka ku mutima, n’ekirabo ky’ateeka mu mukono. Okuwonyezebwa kw’enkolagana ezaalumizibwa tekutandikira ku nkola, wabula ku kusonyiwa, Katonda kw’asobozesa. Era okuzuukuka kw’omwoyo, kw’abadde ayaayaanira okuva lwe yali omuvubuka mu Wales, si kintu ekkanisa ky’esobola okutegeka; kwe kubeerawo kwa Katonda okweyoleka, abantu be kwe beetegekera mu bwetoowaze, mu kwenenya ne mu njala ey’omwoyo.

Alina engeri ennyimpi ey’okwogera ku kawuzi kano, gye yaggya mu kubuulirirwa omukkiriza omukulu e Swansea bwe yali akyali muyizi muto: tambula ne Yesu, nga tomukulembera, era nga tosigala mabega ge. Ekifaananyi ekyo eky’okutambula, nga Mukama y’alambika obwangu bw’okutambula, kye kisumuluzo ekisinga obulungi eky’okutegeera byonna ebiddirira.

Engeri ekitabo kino gye kitegekeddwamu

Oluvannyuma lw’essuula ku bulamu bwe, eyesigamye ku byafaayo bye ebyawandiikibwa Ochorus ne ku kitabo kye yennyini Amayinja ag’Okulinnyako, ekitabo kinnyonnyola enjigiriza ye mu ssuula kkumi na nnya ennyimpi. Essuula omukaaga ezisooka zigenda wamu: okukkiriza kye kiri ne kye kitali, ebika by’okukkiriza ebisatu by’alaba mu Byawandiikibwa, okutambula mu kukkiriza ng’okukwata omukono gwa Kitaffe, essuubi, ejjinja ery’omuwendo eryerabirwa, okuwulira eddoboozi ly’Omusumba, n’amayinja ag’okulinnyako Katonda g’akozesa okuluŋŋamya. Essuula nnya eziddako zikyukira ku bulamu bw’omukkiriza mu Kristo: okubeera mu muzabbibu, obugagga obuli mu kubeera mu ye, okujjula kw’Omwoyo, n’abantu ab’endagaano ab’omu kisenge ekya waggulu. Essuula bbiri ziddirira ku mulamwa gwe ogusinga okuba ogw’obusumba: okuwonyezebwa kw’enkolagana ezaalumizibwa nga tuyita mu kukolagana n’okwesittazibwa, ne mu kusonyiwa n’okusumulula. Essuula bbiri ezisembayo zitwala emigugu gye emikulu ebiri gy’alina eri ekkanisa: nti buli mukkiriza asaanye okusumululwa abuuke ng’empungu mu buweereza Katonda bw’ayagala, era nti ekkanisa esaanye okunoonya okubeerawo kwa Katonda n’ekitiibwa kye. Ekifundikwa kigatta obuwuzi bwonna, era Obulagirizi bw’Omusomi bukulaga ebitabo bye yennyini.

Buli ssuula ekomekkerezebwa n’ebintu eby’okukolerako n’essaala. Ekyo kyagenderere. Evans yasomesa fizikisi okumala emyaka amakumi abiri, era tafiirwangako ndowooza ya musomesa nti essomo eritakolerwako tekiba nti liyigiddwa. Ye yandisoose okugamba nti tewali kiri mu mpapula zino kikulu okuggyako nga kikufukamiza ku maviivi, n’oluvannyuma ne kikufulumya mu luggi.

Kino si kitabo kya Gareth Evans wabula kifunze kya Ochorus ekyetongodde. Tekijuliza bigambo bye n’ekimu, era kyogera amannya g’ebitabo bye buli we kisaanidde osobole okugenda okumusoma ggwe kennyini, kye kintu ekisinga obulungi; obulamu obungi obw’enjigiriza ye buli mu mboozi ze, ekifunze kye kitasobola kuzzaawo.

Ebifo eby’okusomamu n’obwegendereza

Kino si kitabo ekigulumiza omuntu ng’omuzira, era ne Evans teyandikyagadde. Ayagala nnyo okulaga nti abantu aboogerwako mu Abaebbulaniya 11 si bazira n’akatono, wabula basajja na bakazi ab’abulijjo, abaalina obunafu, Katonda be yakulembera. Ekyo kye kimu kye tulina okwogera ku basomesa abatuyamba.

N’olwekyo, omusomi omutegeevu w’ayinza okwagala okupima enjigiriza ye, ekitabo kino kikyogera mu lwatu era mu bukkakkamu. Ensonga nnya zijjawo emirundi egisukka mu gumu. Esooka, Evans ayawula nnyo nnyo okukkiriza, essuubi n’enzikiriza, era azimba bingi ku Luyonaani n’Olwebbulaniya oluli emabega w’ebigambo ebimu. Ensonga ye ey’obusumba ntuufu era yeetaagibwa nnyo, naye ebigambo by’Endagaano Empya tebyawulwa bulijjo bulungi nga bw’abyawula, era ebimu ku by’anoonyereza ku makulu g’ebigambo biwakanyizibwa. Ey’okubiri, ayagala nnyo okuzuula ebifaananyi bya Kristo n’eby’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo mu mboozi z’Endagaano Enkadde, era oluusi asoma mu kantu akatono ebisinga ku ebyo ekyawandiikibwa kyennyini bye kyetaagisa; okusoma okwo kusinga kutwalibwa ng’ebyokulabirako so si ng’enjigiriza. Ey’okusatu, olw’ekkanisa za Pentekoote ne Alliance mwe yakulira, akkiriza nti okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kintu ekyetongodde ekijja oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka; abakkiriza bangi abeesigwa ebitundu bye bimu babitegeera mu ngeri ya njawulo. Ey’okuna, enjigiriza ye ku kusumulula abo abaatulumya yeesigamye ku ngeri emu ey’okutegeera ebigambo bya Yesu ku kusiba, okusumulula n’okusonyiwa ebibi; omutima gwayo, kwe kusonyiwa, gwa Bayibuli mu lwatu, naye emboozi ezigiwerekera bujulirwa bwa kisa kya Katonda, so si bisuubizo bya ngeri buli mbeera gy’eriggwaamu.

Tewali na emu ku zino eba nsonga ya butamusoma. Okubuulirira kw’ekitabo kino kwe kubuulirira kw’Ebyawandiikibwa: Mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga (1 Basessaloniika 5:21). Awo w’abeera omwesigwa eri Ekigambo, era ku kukkiriza, obuwulize, okubeera mu Kristo, okusonyiwa n’okubeerawo kwa Katonda mwesigwa nnyo ddala, kikkirize n’essanyu era okikoleko. Awo w’asukka ku ebyo ebyawandiikibwa, kiteeke ku bbali, toliiko ky’ofiirwa.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Nga tonnaba kweyongerayo kusoma, weebuuze mu mazima obanga otera okukulembera Mukama, okusigala emabega we, oba okutambula naye. Wandiika ekyokulabirako kimu ekyakabaawo.

2. Salawo engeri gy’onoosomamu ekitabo kino, essuula emu buli lunaku oba essuula emu buli wiiki, era kaakano wandiika ebiseera ebyo mu kalenda yo.

3. Yogera ekitundu kimu eky’obulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo mw’obadde ogezaako okufuna olw’okwefuba ekyo Katonda yekka ky’asobola okuwa.

4. Malirira okugeraageranya buli kiri mu mpapula zino n’Ebyawandiikibwa, ng’onyweza ekituufu era ng’oteeka ku bbali ekitali kituufu.

5. Londa ekimu ku bitabo bya Evans ebitaano okuva mu Bulagirizi bw’Omusomi ku nkomerero, osome essuula yaakyo esooka wamu n’essuula esooka ey’enjigiriza wano.

ESSAALA
Kitaffe, oluŋŋamizza entambula yange okumala ebbanga eddene okusinga bwe nnakitegeera, era wakwata omukono gwange nga simanyi nti gukwatiddwa.
Bwe nsoma ku kukkiriza n’essuubi, ku kubeera mu Kristo n’okusonyiwa, ne ku kubeerawo kwo, nkuuma nneme kwewuunya musomesa ne nsubwa Mukama we.
Ebiri mu mpapula zino ebikwatagana n’Ekigambo kyo, biwandiike ku mutima gwange. Ebitakwatagana nakyo, mpa amagezi ag’okwawula mbiteeke wansi.
Nkuuma ku lusegere lwo, Mukama Yesu, nga sikukulembera era nga sisigala mabega, ddaala ku ddaala, okutuusa olugendo lwange bwe luliggwa. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Kirowoozo ki ekimu ekinywevu ekitabo kino kye kisanga nga kiyita mu bitabo byonna ne mu bubaka bwonna obwa Evans?
study_questions.answer: Nti mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo Katonda y’asooka okukola, era omukkiriza ky’alina okukola kwe kukwata omukono gwe n’amugoberera. Evans akikozesa ku kukkiriza, ku bibala eby’omwoyo, ku kuluŋŋamizibwa, ku buweereza, ku kuwonyezebwa kw’enkolagana ne ku kuzuukuka kw’omwoyo.

study_questions.question: Kubuulirira ki okwava eri omukkiriza omukulu e Swansea ekitabo kye kiyita ekisumuluzo ekisinga obulungi eky’enjigiriza ya Evans?
study_questions.answer: Okutambula ne Yesu, nga tomukulembera era nga tosigala mabega ge. Ekifaananyi ky’okutambula, nga Mukama y’alambika obwangu bw’okutambula, ekitabo bwe kigamba, kye kisumuluzo ky’ebyo byonna ebiddirira.

study_questions.question: Lwaki buli ssuula y’ekitabo kino ekomekkerezebwa n’ebintu eby’okukolerako n’essaala?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga Evans yasomesa fizikisi okumala emyaka amakumi abiri era akyalina endowooza y’omusomesa nti essomo eritakolerwako tekiba nti liyigiddwa. Yandigambye nti tewali kiri mu mpapula zino kikulu okuggyako nga kifukamiza omusomi ku maviivi ge, n’oluvannyuma ne kimufulumya mu luggi.

study_questions.question: Bitundu ki ebina ekitabo bye kiraga ng’ebifo omusomi omutegeevu w’ayinza okwagala okupima enjigiriza ya Evans?
study_questions.answer: Okwawula kwe okw’amaanyi ennyo wakati w’okukkiriza, essuubi n’enzikiriza okwesigamye ku kunoonyereza ku bigambo okuwakanyizibwa; empisa ye ey’okusoma ebifaananyi bya Kristo mu tuntu tw’Endagaano Enkadde; endowooza ye nti okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu kintu ekyetongodde ekijja oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka; n’enjigiriza ye ku kusumulula abo abatulumya, eyesigamye ku ngeri emu ey’okutegeera okusiba, okusumulula n’okusonyiwa ebibi. Tewali na kimu ku bino, ekitabo bwe kigamba, ekiba ensonga y’obutamusoma.

fields.title: Okuva mu Biwonvu okutuuka mu Mawanga
fields.body_html:
Ne bwe ndiba nga nkaddiye nga mmeze n’envi, tonjabuliranga, Ayi Katonda, okutuusiza ddala nga mmaze okutendera abo abaliddawo amaanyi go amangi, n’okumanyisa emirembe egigenda okujja obuyinza bwo. ZABBULI 71:18

Omulenzi ow’omu biwonvu. Gareth Evans yazaalibwa mu 1938 mu Merthyr Tydfil, mu biwonvu eby’ebirombe by’amanda ag’amayinja mu bukiikaddyo bwa Wales. Kitaawe, Cyril, yaweereza mu ggye ly’omu bbanga erya Bungereza mu Ssematalo ow’Okubiri, era yajjukirwanga olw’eddoboozi lye ery’okuyimba n’okwagala kwe eri omuzannyo gwa kiriketi; nnyina, Ethel, yali mukubi wa piyano omukugu eyeewaayo okulabirira amaka. Ku myaka munaana yagenda okubeera ewa jjajjaawe e Bonvilston, okumpi ne Cardiff, era ku myaka kkumi n’emu n’ayingira Cowbridge Grammar School, omulenzi eyayagalanga okuvuga eggaali, omupiira n’okunyumya emboozi gye yazuulibwa ng’alina omutwe omulungi ennyo mu kubala okusinga ku bulijjo. Bwe yali wa myaka kkumi n’esatu, nnyina n’afa. Mu kiseera ekyo teyakaaba; abalenzi, nga bwe yali ayigiriziddwa, tebakaaba. Kitaawe teyaddamu kuwasa, n’alabirira amaka yekka, era okufiirwa okwo kwawaliriza omulenzi okwemalirira nga akyali muto.

Ekibuuzo kye yali tasobola kuddamu. Yakulira mu maka g’Abangalikani, ng’amanyi okukkiriza kw’Ekikristaayo naye nga tekunnamukwata mu mutima. Ku myaka kkumi n’omukaaga yatandika okugenda mu nkuŋŋaana z’abavubuka ez’Olwokutaano akawungeezi Betty Bishop ze yakubiranga mu maka ge, obudde bw’okuyimba ennyimba ennyimpi, obw’ebibuuzo bya Bayibuli n’obw’abogezi abaavanga ebweru. Ekiro kimu yamubuuza butereevu kiki ky’agenda okukola ku Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Teyalina ky’addamu, era okumala wiiki eziwerako yamwewala. Awo omubuulizi omuvubuka atali musumba mulonde gwe yali amanyi okuva ku ssomero, bwe yali ayogera mu kkanisa entono okumpi awo, n’amubuuza ekibuuzo kye kimu ddala oluvannyuma lw’okusinza. Ekiro ekyo yafukamira ku mabbali g’obuliri bwe omulundi ogwasooka okuva nnyina lwe yafa, n’asaba Kristo amusonyiwe era ayingire mu bulamu bwe. Tewali kyalabika nti kibaddewo. Ennaku ntono oluvannyuma, bwe yali ayingira mu lukuŋŋaana lw’essomero nga mikwano gye bamusekerera olw’eddiini ye empya, yajjuzibwa okumanya okunywevu nti yali mwana wa Katonda. Okuva olwo tabangako na kubuusabuusa ku ekyo.

Abasomesa n’ekigambo eky’obulamu bwe. Amaka ge ag’omwoyo yagafuna mu kkanisa ya Elim Pentecostal e Bridgend, omusumba waayo Wynne Lewis gye yasuubiranga abakyuse abato okugoberera Kristo n’omutima gwabwe gwonna oba obutamugoberera n’akatono. Ku University of Swansea yasula mu maka ga Donald Evans, omuvubuka Omukristaayo gwe yasisinkana ku kisaawe kya kiriketi, oluvannyuma eyafuuka omuyivu ow’erinnya mu by’empisa mu by’obujjanjabi. Kitaawe wa Donald, Aubrey, omusajja eyali asomye kitono, ye yawa omuyizi oyo okubuulirira okwafuuka ekigambo ekikulembera obulamu bwe: nti abo abagoberera Mukama nga bali wala basobola okumulaba, naye abo abadduka ddaala limu mu maaso g’Omusana gw’ensi beesanga nga batambulira mu kisiikirize kyabwe bo. Okuva mu ekyo mwe mwava okumalirira kwe okutambula ne Yesu, nga tali mu maaso ge wadde emabega we. Mu myaka egyo egy’okusoma, mu kiseera ekiddirira obutiti mu 1961, yafuna n’okulaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu nga akola mu ngeri gy’abadde atwala bulijjo ng’okukoleezebwa kw’omuliro ogutazikirangako.

Omukugu wa ssaayansi mu kibiina ky’essomero. Yafuna diguli ey’ekitiibwa mu fizikisi e Swansea, ne dipulooma mu by’okusomesa. Eyo gye yasisinkanira Anne, omuwala omukkakkamu eyali omuwandiisi mu kkanisa y’emu, kitaawe ow’e Norway yali muweereza wa njiri, ate nnyina yali omu ku kibiina ky’abasabi ekyakwatagana ne Rees Howells. Baafumbiriganwa mu 1961. Okumala emyaka amakumi abiri egyaddirira, ekituuti kye kyali kibiina ky’essomero. Yasomesa fizikisi e Kenfig, oluvannyuma, nga akyali muto nnyo mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa, n’alondebwa okusomesa abaana b’amaka g’abaserikale ba Bungereza mu Bugirimaani, e Hamm, era oluvannyuma n’amagye ga Bungereza mu Hong Kong. Eyo yeegatta ku Jackie Pullinger, eyali akyali omuto, mu kukyalira Ekibuga Ekyetooloddwa Bbugwe ekya Kowloon ekyali kimanyiddwa ennyo olw’obubi, era n’akulembera okusoma Bayibuli eri abaserikale ba Bungereza n’abaserikale ba Gurkha. Bwe yakomawo mu Wales okuva mu 1969, yafuuka omukulu w’ekitongole kya fizikisi mu Ogmore Grammar School, yaweereza ku kakiiko akaali kategeka enteekateeka empya ey’okusoma ku mutendera ogwa waggulu, era, wamu ne Anne, yalaba okusoma Bayibuli okutono kw’abawala abavubuka mu maka gaabwe nga kukula ne kufuuka omulimu gw’abavubuka mu kkanisa zonna ez’omu kitundu kya Bridgend. Abavubuka bangi bajja mu kukkiriza, era abamu ku bo oluvannyuma baagamba nti baali babeera mu kuzuukuka kw’omwoyo nga tebakimanyi.

Canada, n’essomero ly’abalabbi. Mu 1975 amaka gaasenguka ne gagenda e Canada. Evans yakulira ekitongole kya fizikisi mu Toronto French School, oluvannyuma ekitongole kya ssaayansi mu Toronto Hebrew Academy, essomero ly’Abayudaaya abanywerera ku nnono enkadde, gye yali omu ku Bannamawanga babiri bokka mu basomesa. Eyo, ng’ayitiddwa, yeesanga ng’addamu ebibuuzo by’abayizi abakulu ebikwata ku Kristo, era ng’ayogera ku makulu ga ssaddaaka n’omulabbi omukulu w’essomero, emboozi z’abala mu bintu ebisinga obukulu mu bulamu bwe.

Omusomesa eyafuuka omusumba. Mu Toronto omulabirizi w’ekitundu w’ekkanisa ye yamusaba alowooze ku kufuuka omusumba mu Christian and Missionary Alliance. Evans yagamba nti teyandigenze nga tafunye kuyitibwa okutegeerekeka okuva eri Katonda, era nti teyalina ssente za kusoma mu ttendekero ly’abasumba; ne bamugamba nti ettendekero teryetaagisa, era nti ekyetaagibwa bwe bujulirwa bw’ab’oluganda. Mu myezi egyaddirira obujulirwa obwo bwajja, awatali abuyigiriza, okuva mu njuyi eziwerako. Anne, eyakulira mu bwavu mu maka g’omubuulizi w’enjiri omutambuze era nga tayagala kuba mukyala wa musumba, yamugamba nti obanga Katonda yali amuyita, kyali kisinga obulungi agondere. Yaleka emu ku mirimu gy’okusomesa egisinga okusasula obulungi mu ggwanga lyonna n’akkiriza omusaala gw’omusumba. Yasooka kuweereza mu Hazelglen Fellowship e Kitchener, Ontario, ekibiina ekitono gye kyakula ne kizimba ekizimbe kyakyo, oluvannyuma okumala ekiseera ekitono e Sidney ku kizinga Vancouver Island, era okuva mu 1984 ng’omusumba wa Victoria Alliance Church, mu kibuga ekibadde amaka ge okuva olwo.

Okugenda ku nnyanja. Mu 1990 obutasobola kwebaka, abasawo kye baavunaana okunyigirizibwa mu birowoozo, kwamuwaliriza okulekulira. Kyali kiwonvu kya kizikiza, era oluvannyuma yazuula nti ekitundu kyakyo kyava mu nnaku ze yali teyolekangako, nga zaddayo ku kufa kwa nnyina. Awo n’ajja okuyitibwa okuweereza ne Anne ng’abasumba ku kyombo ky’okusaasira ekiyitibwa Anastasis, era okuva mu 1991 okutuusa ku nkomerero ya 1994 baabeeranga ku kyombo nga kikola mu Afirika ey’Ebugwanjuba. Ng’oggyeeko okulongoosa abalwadde, okuzimba n’emirimu gy’amazzi amayonjo egy’ekyombo, Evans yayigirizanga abasumba n’abakulembeze b’ekkanisa, nga mw’otwalidde emisomo egya buli wiiki eri abakulembeze abasoba mu kikumi mu ataano mu Sierra Leone, n’enkuŋŋaana mu Guinea, Côte d’Ivoire, Senegal ne Nigeria.

Okutuuka ku nkomerero z’ensi. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyombo, Anne yamukubiriza aleme kutwala kibiina kirala wabula atambule ng’ayigiriza, ye n’aggulawo amaka gaabwe e Victoria eri abayizi okubawagira. Okuyitibwa kwajja nga takunoonyezza: essomero lya Bayibuli ery’omu biseera by’oluwummula e Australia, okuyigiriza kwe ku kisenge ekya waggulu gye kwafuukira ekitabo kye ekisooka; amasomero g’okutendeka aga Youth With A Mission mu Mexico ne Brazil; enkuŋŋaana z’abasumba mu Baja California, Haiti, India ne Nepal. Obulwadde obw’ebbanga eddene oluvannyuma lw’okulongoosebwa mu 2003 bwamukuumira awaka okumala emyaka ebiri, era yagimala ng’asoma, ng’awandiika ebitontome era ng’ayongera okukka mu bulamu obw’okusaba. Oluvannyuma yaluŋŋamya omuvubuka eyatandikawo omukutu gwa SermonIndex, n’ayamba okukulembera enkuŋŋaana eziwerako ku kuzuukuka kw’omwoyo, era obubaka bwe bungi bwafuna abawuliriza mu nsi yonna. Ebitabo bye, bw’agamba, byawandiikibwa lwa nsonga emu yokka: abantu baasigala babuuza obanga okuyigiriza kwe kwaliwo mu buwandiike.

Okukwata omukono ogukutte ennaku ez’omu maaso. Gareth ne Anne baazaala abaana ab’obuwala basatu, era mu kiseera baafuna abazzukulu bangi n’abazzukulu b’abazzukulu. Anne, munne gwe yamala naye emyaka egisoba mu nkaaga, yamala emyaka mingi ng’alina kookolo, n’afiira awaka waabwe mu Ddesemba 2025; awandiise ku ye n’okwebaza okw’amaanyi, era amuwa ekitiibwa ku bingi abalala bye bamutenderezza. Ng’asemberedde emyaka kyenda, nga bw’ayogera yennyini, afunye omulimu omupya mu baafuuka abaddu b’ebiragalalagala n’abatalina we basula mu Victoria, ng’aluŋŋamya abafumbo abajja eri Kristo nga bava mu bulamu obwo, era kaakano abaweereza mu nguudo ze baali bamanyi. Yeeyogerako mu bufunze nga musinza, era obulamu bwe ng’olunyiriri lw’amayinja ag’okulinnyako Katonda ge yassaawo limu ku limu. Ekyo si kifunze kibi eky’ebyo by’ayigiriza.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Noonyereza ku mayinja ag’okulinnyako ag’obulamu bwo. Wandiika ebintu bisatu ebyakubaako, nga mw’otwalidde waakiri ekimu ekyakuggwamu essuubi, mw’osobola kaakano okulaba Katonda ng’akukulembera.

2. Evans yajja mu kukkiriza kubanga abantu babiri baamubuuza ekibuuzo kye kimu ekitereevu. Waliwo omuntu gw’osaanidde okubuuza ekibuuzo ekyangu era eky’amazima ku Kristo omwezi guno?

3. Lowooza obanga mu bulamu bwo mulimu ennaku enkadde gy’otaleetangako eri Katonda. Musabe, mpola, akulage.

4. Anne okwagala okugoberera okuyitibwa kwa Katonda kwabumba obuweereza bwonna obwa bba. Weebaze Katonda ng’oyogera erinnya ly’omuntu obuwulize bwe obusirifu obwasobozesa obuweereza bwo.

5. Weebuuze obanga okemeddwa okulowooza nti emyaka gyo egy’omugaso giyise. Wandiika engeri emu gy’okyasobola okuweereza omulembe guno.

ESSAALA
Mukama Katonda, wali okola mu biwonvu ne mu bibiina by’essomero, ku kyombo ne mu nguudo z’ekibuga, nga omuddu wo tannakiraba. Okola mu bulamu bwange mu ngeri y’emu.
Nkwebaza ku buli jjinja ery’okulinnyako, era onsonyiwe ebiseera bye nneemulugunya ku luggi oluggale lwe waggala olw’okwagala.
Wonya ennaku enkadde ze nnaziika, era onfuule eyeetegefu okugenda yonna gy’onkulembera, ku myaka gyonna.
Kwata omukono gwange leero, era okwate ennaku zange ez’omu maaso, okutuusa lwe ndikulaba amaaso ku maaso. Amiina.

fields.title: Okukkiriza Kye Kitali
fields.body_html:
Naye awatali kukkiriza toyinza kusanyusa Katonda. Buli ajja eri Katonda kimugwanira okukkiriza nti Katonda waali era n’abo abamunoonya n’obwesigwa abawa empeera. ABAEBBULANIYA 11:6

Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye tekitandika na nnyinyonnyola wabula n’ekiwundu. Evans anyumya ku mukazi gwe yakyalira mu bulwadde obw’ebbanga eddene obwali butategeerekeka, omukkiriza omwesigwa eyali takyasobola kuva mu nnyumba ye. Lumu yamusanga ng’akaaba. Mukwano gwe ow’omu kkanisa ye yali amukubidde essimu okumugamba nti ekibiina ky’okusaba kyali kisazeewo okulekera awo okumusabira, kubanga singa yali n’okukkiriza okumala, yandibadde yawona dda. Evans yalaba amangu ago nti waliwo ekyali kyonoonese nnyo mu ndowooza ekkanisa eyo gye yalina ku kukkiriza, era n’awandiika ekitabo kyonna okukitereeza.

Entandikwa eyo ekulaga lwaki omulamwa guno mukulu gy’ali. Eri Evans okukkiriza si njigiriza ya mu bwongo bwokka; mbeera ya bwangu mu busumba. Endowooza enkyamu ku kukkiriza zikola akabi ka ddala. Zitikka abalwadde omusango, zisindika ekkanisa mu kusalawo okw’obusirusiru, era zigoba abakkiriza abaggiddwamu essuubi okuva ku Katonda, nga bakakasa nti abaleseeyo. N’olwekyo, nga tannayogera okukkiriza kye kiri, asooka kulongoosa ttaka ng’ayogera kye kitali.

Okukkiriza si nzikiriza yokka

Okutabulwa okusooka kuli wakati w’okukkiriza n’enzikiriza. Evans tategeeza nti okukkiriza ebintu ebituufu tekuli kikulu; ategeeza nti okukkiriziganya mu mutwe si kwe kukkiriza okulokola oba okusanyusa Katonda. Yakobo ensonga eno agyogera mu lwatu ddala:

Okukkiriza obukkiriza nti waliwo Katonda omu yekka, kirungi. Naye ne baddayimooni nabo bakkiriza n’okukankana ne bakankana! YAKOBO 2:19

Okunoonyereza, Evans bw’alaga, kutera okulaga nti abantu bangi nnyo mu nsi nga Canada bakkiriza nti Yesu yazuukira okuva mu bafu. Naye tekireeta njawulo erabika mu ngeri gye bawangaalamu. Enzikiriza erekera obulamu nga tebukyuse si y’Endagaano Empya gy’eyita okukkiriza.

Ajjukira engeri, ku ssomero ly’Abayudaaya gye yasomesanga e Toronto, omulabbi omukulu gye yamubuulira mu kyama ennaku gye yalina nti abayizi be baali bakkiriza Katonda mu mitwe gyokka. Evans, mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye, ekiwoobe ky’omulabbi akizza ku kkanisa. Bangi abatuula ku ntebe zaffe, bw’alowooza, bali ddala ng’abayizi abo: balina okumanya kw’omutwe naye tebalina kumanya kulamu okwa Kristo.

Okukkiriza si kwetulinkiriza

Okutabulwa okw’okubiri kuli wakati w’okukkiriza n’okwetulinkiriza. Evans anyumya ku kkanisa, mu bitabo bye n’obubaka bwe obusukka mu kimu, ezasalawo okuzimba okusukka ennyo ku busobozi bwazo kubanga Katonda yali alabika ng’abawa omukisa, ne bavumirira buli eyalonzalonza nti abulwa okukkiriza. Amagoba ku looni bwe gaalinnya era omukozesa omukulu ow’omu kitundu n’aggalawo, ebbanja lyabanyigiriza, abantu ne bagenda, era bangi ne bamaliriza nga banenya Katonda. Mu ndowooza ye, baali batabudde zzaala ey’eddiini n’okukkiriza, nga mu kyama balowooza nti zzaala bw’eneegwa, omusango gunaaba gwa Katonda.

Ekyokulabirako ekisinga okulaga enjawulo, eri Evans, kwe kukemebwa kwa Yesu. Setaani amusaba afuule amayinja emigaati, era yeesuule okuva ku yeekaalu, ng’ajuliza Ebyawandiikibwa okukakasa nti bamalayika bajja kumukwata. Yesu yandisobodde okukola byombi. Naye okukolera ku kisuubizo ebweru w’okwagala kwa Kitaawe tekwandibadde kukkiriza; kwandibadde kwetulinkiriza.

Yesu n’addamu nti, “Kyawandiikibwa nti, ‘Tokemanga Mukama Katonda wo.’ ” LUKKA 4:12

Evans wano yeegendereza. Tanyooma abo abazimba obulamu bwabwe ku bisuubizo bya Katonda; agamba mu lwatu nti mulimu ebirungi bingi mu kuyigiriza abantu okuyimirira ku Kigambo. Naye akakasa nti tulina okusoma Ekigambo mu ngeri entuufu, okwetwalira ebisuubizo byokka ebitukwatako, n’okutuukiriza obukwakkulizo bwabyo awali obukwakkulizo. Ebisuubizo ebimu tebirina kakwakkulizo: tewali kiyinza kwawukanya mukkiriza n’okwagala kwa Katonda. Ebirala, ng’emirembe n’essanyu Yesu bye yasuubiza mu kisenge ekya waggulu, bya abo abakwata ekigambo kye.

Okukkiriza si ssuubi

Okutabulwa okw’okusatu kwe kumu Evans kw’addangamu buli kiseera: okutabula okukkiriza n’essuubi. Bingi ebiyitibwa okukkiriza mu kuyigiriza okw’omulembe guno, bw’alowooza, ddala ssuubi. Omukristaayo bw’agamba, mu ngeri emu oba endala, nti Katonda yakyogera, ye akikkiriza era ekyo kikiggwera, aba alaga okusuubira okunywevu okw’ebyo Katonda bye yasuubiza. Ekyo kintu kya muwendo, naye ssuubi. Evans enjawulo eno agifunza, mu bitabo bye ebiwerako, mu kugeraageranya okwangu: essuubi liri mu birowoozo era lyeyoleka mu bwesige; okukkiriza kuli mu mutima era kweyoleka mu buwulize. Akabonero k’ekyo akalaba mu kifaananyi kya Pawulo eky’eby’okulwanyisa by’Omukristaayo:

Naye ffe, kubanga tuli ba musana, tulemenga okutamiira. Twambale okukkiriza n’okwagala ng’ekyomu kifuba, era tube n’essuubi ery’obulokozi nga ye nkufiira yaffe. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:8

Ekyomu kifuba kikuuma omutima, era kwe kukkiriza n’okwagala; enkufiira ekuuma omutwe, era lye ssuubi. Essuula ey’omukaaga ey’ekitabo kino ejja kuddamu okwogera ku ssuubi, Evans ly’alowooza nti ekkanisa erirekeredde nnyo.

Okukkiriza si kulowooza birungi byokka

Okutabulwa okw’okuna kuli n’okulowooza ebirungi byokka. Ensi ey’ebyobusuubuzi, Evans bw’alaga, ebadde dda eyigiriza nti ky’olowooza nti oli, ky’ofuuka, era ekitundu ekinene eky’ekkanisa kyewola endowooza eyo. Wano w’asinga okwogera n’obukambwe ku basomesa abagamba abalwadde okwegaana obubonero bw’obulwadde bwabwe n’abaavu okwatula obugagga, ne ku kukozesa enkola y’okwekubira ebifaananyi mu birowoozo mu kusabira okuwonyezebwa. Togenda, bw’agamba mu ngeri emu, kwerowooleza mu bulamu obulungi oba mu kuddibwamu kw’okusaba. Okuyigiriza okw’engeri eyo si kukkiriza, ne bwe bajuliza Ebyawandiikibwa bingi batya okukuwagira.

Wabula ne wano mwenkanya. Akkiriza okuwonya kwa Katonda, ng’ennono ya Alliance mwe yaweerereza bw’ebadde ekikkiriza bulijjo, era atwala okuwonyezebwa ng’obumu ku bugagga obwafunibwa ku musaalaba. Ye kennyini amanyi Katonda ng’awonya. Naye akakasa nti tewali nkola ya kukufuna, nti Katonda asigala nga y’afuga mu kukugaba, era nti tewali bungi bwa kukkiriza, kusaba oba kukaaba obuyinza kumuwaliriza. Omusajja eyakaabirira Yesu ku lwa mutabani we, eri Evans, ky’ekyokulabirako ky’okukkiriza ekisinga ennyo oyo eyeewaana mu kwetwalira ebisuubizo:

Amangwago Kitaawe w’omwana n’ayogerera waggulu nti, “Nzikiriza, naye nnyamba okukkiriza kwange kweyogereko!” MAKKO 9:24

Okupima enjawulo zino

Ebigambo bya Evans bino ebina eby’okugaana birimu amagezi ag’obusumba, era abakkiriza bangi nnyo bisumuluddwa. Kisaana okwongerako, mu bukkakkamu, nti Endagaano Empya tebulijjo nti eyawula ebigambo bino nga ye bw’abyawula. Ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani ekitegeeza okukkiriza n’ekikolwa ekitegeeza okukkiriza birina ekikolo kye kimu, n’olwekyo mu Njiri ya Yokaana okukkiriza Kristo kwe kuba n’okukkiriza mu ye. Essuubi n’okukkiriza nabyo biraluddwa wamu nnyo mu Abaebbulaniya 11:1. Evans yennyini akkiriza nti okukkiriza okulokola kutandikira ku kukkiriza mu mutwe, era ky’alwanyisa ddala si kukkiriza kwennyini wabula okukkiriza okutatuuka ku mutima wadde ku kwagala kw’omuntu. Bw’osoma bw’otyo, enjawulo ze ziyamba, so si bigambo bipya bye tulina okukaka abantu.

Ensonga esingako obuziba esigala nga nnywevu. Okukkiriza si bungi bwe tweyubulira, era okubulwa kwakwo si kwe kunnyonnyola buli nnaku. Tewali mukkiriza n’omu asaanye kugamba muganda we oba mwannyina abonaabona nti abe n’okukkiriza okusingawo, ng’olinga ensonga eri mu mikono gyabwe.

Omutuukirivu wange, anaabanga mulamu lwa kukkiriza, kyokka bw’adda emabega simusanyukira. ABAEBBULANIYA 10:38

Abatuukirivu babeera balamu lwa kukkiriza; tebabeera balamu lwa nneewulira, nkola oba bwesige obw’okwekaka. Okukkiriza okwo kye kiri ddala gwe mulamwa gw’essuula eddako.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Lowooza ku kiseera ggwe, oba omuntu ali okumpi naawe, lwe yagambibwa nti obuzibu bwali buva mu kubulwa okukkiriza. Kyakukwatako kitya? Leeta ekijjukizo ekyo mu mazima eri Katonda.

2. Weebuuze kutabulwa ki ku bina, enzikiriza etaliimu bulamu, okwetulinkiriza, essuubi eritwalibwa ng’okukkiriza, oba okulowooza ebirungi byokka, kw’osinga okutera okugwamu.

3. Tunuulira emabega ku kusalawo kw’olumu wayita eddaala ly’okukkiriza. Kwali kwanukula Katonda mu buwulize, oba kwali kwetulinkiriza? Kiki ky’owandikoze mu ngeri ya njawulo?

4. Bw’oba omanyi omuntu omulwadde oba ali mu buzibu, malirira obutayogera ku bunene bw’okukkiriza kwe. Mukyalire, osabe naye, era beerawo bubeezi.

5. Soma Lukka 4:1–13 mpola era weetegereze engeri Yesu gy’addamu buli kukemebwa n’Ebyawandiikibwa ebitegeerekese obulungi.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, wagaana okwetulinkiriza ku Kitaawo ne bwe wali enjala ekuluma era nga oli wekka. Nkuuma nneme kukozesa bisuubizo byo ng’ebikozesebwa okutuukiriza okwagala kwange.
Onsonyiwe olw’ebiseera bye ntabudde obwesige n’okukkiriza, oba enzikiriza ey’omu mutwe n’okukwesiga okw’omu mutima.
Bwe mba nga nnalumya abalala nga ndaga nti okubonaabona kwabwe kwava mu kubulwa kwabwe okukkiriza, nsonyiwa, era ofuule omukkakkamu.
Nzikiriza, naye nnyamba okukkiriza kwange kweyogereko! Amiina.

study_questions.question: Kiki ekitandika Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye, era lwaki kiraga nti okukkiriza kukulu nnyo eri Evans?
study_questions.answer: Omukkiriza omwesigwa eyalina obulwadde obw’ebbanga eddene obutategeerekeka yagambibwa nti ekibiina ky’okusaba eky’ekkanisa ye kyali kigenda kulekera awo okumusabira, kubanga singa yali n’okukkiriza okumala yandibadde yawona dda. N’olwekyo eri Evans okukkiriza si njigiriza ya mu bwongo bwokka wabula mbeera ya bwangu mu busumba, kubanga endowooza enkyamu ku kwo zitikka abalwadde omusango, zisindika ekkanisa mu kusalawo okw’obusirusiru, era zigoba abakkiriza okuva ku Katonda.

study_questions.question: Evans akozesa atya okukemebwa kwa Yesu okwawula okukkiriza n’okwetulinkiriza?
study_questions.answer: Setaani yasaba Yesu afuule amayinja emigaati era yeesuule okuva ku yeekaalu, ng’ajuliza Ebyawandiikibwa nti bamalayika bandimukwase. Yesu yandisobodde okukola byombi, naye okukolera ku kisuubizo ebweru w’okwagala kwa Kitaawe tekwandibadde kukkiriza; kwandibadde kwetulinkiriza.

study_questions.question: Kugeraageranya ki okwangu Evans kw’akola wakati w’essuubi n’okukkiriza?
study_questions.answer: Essuubi liri mu birowoozo era lyeyoleka mu bwesige; okukkiriza kuli mu mutima era kweyoleka mu buwulize. Akabonero k’ekyo akalaba mu 1 Basessaloniika 5:8, okukkiriza n’okwagala we biri ekyomu kifuba ekikuuma omutima, ate essuubi nga y’enkufiira ekuuma omutwe.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans agaana okulowooza ebirungi byokka okutwalibwa ng’okukkiriza, sso ng’akyakkiriza okuwonya kwa Katonda?
study_questions.answer: Agamba nti tosobola kwerowooleza mu bulamu obulungi oba mu kuddibwamu kw’okusaba, era ayogera n’obukambwe ku kugamba abalwadde okwegaana obubonero bw’obulwadde bwabwe oba abaavu okwatula obugagga. Akkiriza nti Katonda awonya era atwala okuwonyezebwa ng’obumu ku bugagga obwafunibwa ku musaalaba, naye akakasa nti tewali nkola ya kukufuna, Katonda asigala nga y’afuga, era tewali bungi bwa kukkiriza, kusaba oba kukaaba obuyinza kumuwaliriza.

study_questions.question: Essuula eraga etya nti enjawulo za Evans ez’amaanyi wakati w’okukkiriza, enzikiriza n’essuubi zisaana okusomebwa?
study_questions.answer: Ng’obuyambi obw’obusumba so si bigambo bye tulina okukaka abantu, kubanga mu Luyonaani ekigambo ekitegeeza okukkiriza n’ekikolwa ekitegeeza okukkiriza birina ekikolo kimu, era Abaebbulaniya 11:1 eraluza wamu essuubi n’okukkiriza. Ky’alwanyisa ddala si kukkiriza kwennyini wabula okukkiriza okutatuuka ku mutima wadde ku kwagala kw’omuntu.

fields.title: Ebika by’Okukkiriza Ebisatu
fields.body_html:
Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw’okukkiriza. Tekwava mu mmwe, wabula kirabo kya Katonda. Tekwatuweebwa lwa bikolwa byaffe; noolwekyo omuntu yenna aleme okwenyumirizanga. ABAEFESO 2:8–9

Bw’amala okuggyawo okukkiriza kye kitali, Evans akyukira ku Byawandiikibwa kye byogera ku kwo. Bw’asoma Bayibuli, bw’abuulira abasomi be mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye era ne mu Okuliira ku Mmeeza, asanga okukkiriza nga kwogerwako mu ngeri ssatu ez’enjawulo: okukkiriza okulokola, ekibala ky’okukkiriza, n’ekirabo ky’okukkiriza. Entegeka eno nnyangu, kumpi ng’ensengeka y’omusomesa w’essomero, era ekyo kye kimu ku bigifuula ey’omugaso. Naye ekyo ky’agiggyamu kya buziba, era kiyita mu njigiriza ye yonna esigaddeyo.

Okukkiriza okulokola

Ekika ky’okukkiriza ekisooka kwe kukkiriza kwe tulokolebwa. Evans asoma Abaefeso 2:8 ng’eyigiriza nti n’okukkiriza kuno si kintu kye tuggya mu busobozi bwaffe ffekka. Tuyinza okulonda okukkiriza era ne twagala okukkiriza, naye obusobozi bw’okwesiga Kristo okutuuka ku kulokolebwa buva eri Katonda. Tewali, bw’agamba mu ngeri emu, tterekero lya kukkiriza mu ffe eririndiridde okusenebwamu.

Kuno kwe kukkiriza buli mukkiriza eyazaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri kw’agabana n’abalala. Olw’okwo tuweebwa obutuukirivu, ne tubalibwa nga batuukirivu ku lwa Kristo, ne tuyingizibwa mu maka ga Katonda. Evans wano ayagala nnyo okumala ebbanga ng’ayogera ku kisa. Ayagala okuteeka ekisa n’okusaasira kumpi na kumpi, nga ababuulizi bangi bwe bakoze: ekisa kituyiwako ebirungi bye tutaakolerera, n’okusaasira kutuwonya omusango gwe twakolerera ddala. Okukkiriza okulokola kufuna byombi.

Kale nga bwe twaweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza tulina emirembe ne Katonda, mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. ABARUUMI 5:1

Naye Evans ayongerako ekintu ekinakuwaza kye yalaba mu myaka emingi gye yamala ng’omusumba. Abakristaayo bangi, bw’alowooza, tebakulaakulana nnyo okusukka entandikwa eno. Ekipimo ky’okukula akisanga mu bigambo by’omutume Yokaana eri abaana abato, abavubuka n’abakulu:

Era nammwe abakulu, mbawandiikidde kubanga mwamutegeera okuva ku lubereberye. Nammwe abavubuka, mbawandiikidde kubanga muwangudde omubi. Mmwe abaana abaagalwa bawandiikidde, kubanga mutegedde Kitaffe. 1 YOKAANA 2:13

Zino si myaka wabula mitendera, Evans bw’akakkatira. Asisinkanye abakkiriza abato abaali dda bakitaabwe ne bannyaabwe mu kukkiriza, n’abakadde mu kkanisa abaali bakyali baana. Omwana omuto amanyi nti ebibi bye bisonyiyiddwa era asobola okuyita Katonda Kitaffe; omuvubuka wa maanyi, Ekigambo kibeera mu ye era awangula omubi; omukulu atuuse okumanya oyo eyaliwo okuva ku lubereberye. Okukkiriza okulokola gwe mulyango, so si nnyumba.

Ekibala ky’okukkiriza

Ekika ky’okukkiriza eky’okubiri kye kibala ky’Omwoyo. Mu Bayibuli ey’Olungereza eya King James, olukalala mu Abaggalatiya 5 lulimu okukkiriza nga kwogerwako mu linnya; mu Luganda ekigambo ekyo kivvuunulwa nti obwesigwa:

Naye ebibala eby’Omwoyo bye bino: okwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, ekisa, obulungi, obwesigwa, obuwombeefu, okwefuga; awali ebyo tewali tteeka libiwakanya. ABAGGALATIYA 5:22–23

Evans kino akinnyonnyola n’emboozi gy’amaze emyaka ng’anyumya mu bitabo ne ku bituuti, era gy’akkiriza mu lwatu nti yagiyiiya. Ye ne Anne, nga batudde mu nnimiro yaabwe e Canada akawungeezi akamu mu biseera by’omusana, baawulira omuntu ng’asinda n’oluvannyuma ng’assa ekikkowe eky’okuweera, ne bakyuka ne balaba omuti gwa apo nga gwekaka okutuusa apo emu lwe yabbuluka n’erabika ku ttabi. Awo emiti gya pulamu n’egya cheri ne gitandika okukola kye kimu. Tewali, kya lwatu, akkiriza mboozi eyo. Emiti tegizaala bibala lwa kwekaka. Naye, Evans bw’agamba, eyo y’engeri ddala abakkiriza bangi gye balowooza nti ekibala ky’Omwoyo kizaalibwamu: nga bafuba nnyo.

Omuti gubala ebibala nga guyimirira we gwasimbibwa Katonda, nga gunywa enkuba era nga gusika amazzi okuva mu ttaka. Ekibala kwe kweyoleka okw’obutonde okw’obulamu obuli munda.

Afaanana ng’omuti ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’omugga, ogubala ebibala byagwo mu ntuuko zaabyo, n’ebikoola byagwo tebiwotoka. Na buli ky’akola kivaamu birungi byereere. ZABBULI 1:3

Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’ekibala ky’okukkiriza. Kikula mpola, okumala emyaka, mu mukkiriza abeera mu Kristo. Kyetaaga okusalirwa, obugumiikiriza n’okwesiga, naye si kwekaka. Evans ayongerako okubuulirira okw’omugaso okumufaanana: mu kifo ky’okwekebejja buli kiseera amatabi gaffe nga tunoonya obubonero bw’ebibala, kyandisinze tukyuse amaaso gaffe tutunuulire Omuzabbibu.

Era alaba nti ebibala Pawulo by’awandiika birabika ng’ebigenda bikendeera okulabika nga olukalala bwe lugenda mu maaso. Abakkiriza abapya abasinga obungi bakomba ku kwagala, essanyu n’emirembe mangu; obwesigwa, obuwombeefu n’okwefuga bitono era birwawo okwengera. Era ekigambo ekibala kiri mu bumu. Bino si bibala mwenda ebyawukana wabula kibala kimu ekyeyoleka mu ngeri ez’enjawulo, ng’obulamu bwa Kristo obumu bwe bubumbibwa mu ffe.

Ekirabo ky’okukkiriza

Ekika ky’okukkiriza eky’okusatu kye kimu ku birabo by’Omwoyo ebiwandiikiddwa mu 1 Abakkolinso 12:

Omulala Omwoyo y’omu n’amuwa okukkiriza, n’omulala n’amuwa obuyinza okuwonyanga abalwadde. 1 ABAKKOLINSO 12:9

Evans kino akitegeera ng’obukakafu obw’enjawulo Katonda bw’agaba olw’embeera emu, obuweebwa olw’obulungi bw’omubiri gwonna. Akinnyonnyola n’embeera gy’ayogeddeko emirundi egisukka mu gumu: olukiiko lw’ekkanisa olwasattulukana ku nsonga y’okukozesa omukozi w’abavubuka gwe lutalina ssente kusasula. Ab’olukiiko basaba era boogera, awo omu eyali ayingidde ng’akiwakanya n’agamba nti waliwo ekikyuse mu ye bwe yali awuliriza; kati amanyi nti Mukama ali mu nsonga eyo. Mu ddakiika ntono bonna bakkiriziganya. Ekyo, eri Evans, kye kirabo ky’okukkiriza: Katonda okusimba mu bantu be, olw’ekiseera ekyo n’obwetaavu obwo, obwesige obuwangula embeera.

Era anyumya ku mukwano gwe omuvubuka mu Wales eyalina okunaanuuka okw’amaanyi ennyo, eyagaana okubuulirirwa kwonna, nga mw’otwalidde n’okwa Evans yennyini, n’akkiriza okupangisa ekisenge okubuulira ab’ekibuga ky’ewaabwe Kristo kye yali amukoledde, n’ayogera bulungi omulundi ogwasooka mu bulamu bwe. Katonda yali awadde omuddu we omunafu okukkiriza olw’essaawa eyo.

Byonna biva eri Katonda

Bw’amala okulambika ebika ebyo ebisatu, Evans ayogera ekintu ekifuga buli kimu ekirala ky’ayigiriza ku kukkiriza. Byonna ebisatu biva eri Katonda, so si eri omukkiriza. Okukkiriza okulokola kirabo kye; ekibala ky’okukkiriza kwe kukula Omwoyo we kw’aleeta mu ffe; ekirabo ky’okukkiriza kwe kweyoleka kw’Omwoyo we ng’ayita mu ffe. Tewali kye tuyinza kukola okweyubulira okukkiriza.

Nga tutunuulira Yesu eyatandika okukkiriza era y’akutuukiriza, olw’essanyu lye yali alindirira bwe yagumiikiriza omusaalaba, ng’anyooma ensonyi, n’atuula ku luuyi olwa ddyo olw’entebe ya Katonda. ABAEBBULANIYA 12:2

Eno y’ensonga lwaki yegayirira, n’enneewulira ey’amaanyi, nti tewali n’omu asaanye kugamba mukkiriza omulwadde oba ali mu buzibu nti abe n’okukkiriza okusingawo. Omuntu ng’oyo ky’alina okukulaakulanyamu, bw’agamba, kwe kwesiga: okwagala buli lunaku okwesigama ku Katonda n’okumugondera. Ekyo tusobola okukituukako, kubanga kwe kwanukula kwokka okw’omwana eri Kitaawe eyamala dda okukola.

Abasomi abamu bajja kwagala okwongerako nti Endagaano Empya era eragira okukkiriza era etendereza abo abakulaakulana mu kwo; okukkiriza kirabo kya Katonda, naye era ddala kwe kwanukula kwaffe, era Ebyawandiikibwa tebiteeka bibiri ebyo kuwakanagana. Evans yandikkirizza. Ekimweraliikiriza kye kikolo. Okukkiriza bwe kutwalibwa ng’ekintu omuntu ky’atuuseeko, amalala n’okuggwamu essuubi bigoberera kumpi. Bwe kufunibwa ng’omulimu gwa Katonda, omukkiriza atoowazibwa era asumululwa.

Noolwekyo okukkiriza kujja olw’okuwulira ekigambo kya Kristo. ABARUUMI 10:17

N’olwekyo, ekkubo erigasa si kwekaka okunoonya okukkiriza wabula okweteeka Katonda w’akugabira: mu Kigambo kye, mu kusaba, mu bantu be, nga tubeera mu Muzabbibu.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Ng’okozesa emitendera esatu egya Yokaana, omwana omuto, omuvubuka n’omukulu, weebuuze mu mazima w’oli mu kutambula kwo ne Katonda. Toggwaamu maanyi olw’eky’okuddamu; weebuuze eddaala eriddako liyinza kuba ki.

2. Wandiika ebibala by’Omwoyo omwenda era osaze wansi w’ekyo ekirabika ng’ekisinga okubulwa mu bulamu bwo. Mu kifo ky’okumalirira okwongera okufuba, wiiki eno mala ebiseera ng’obeera bubeezi mu Kristo mu kusaba ne mu Kigambo.

3. Jjukira ekiseera ggwe, oba ekkanisa yo, lwe mwaweebwa obwesige obutasuubirwa nti Katonda yali mu kintu. Mwebaze olw’ekyo.

4. Ebigambo nti beera n’okukkiriza okusingawo bigye mu by’oyogera, obiddize n’okwewaayo okusaba, okuyamba oba okubeera ku lusegere.

5. Soma Abaruumi 10:17 era otegeke ebiseera ebya bulijjo okuwulira Ekigambo, so si okukisoma kwokka.

ESSAALA
Kitaffe, saakuzuula olw’okukkiriza kwange nze. Ggwe wazibula amaaso gange n’ompa okukkiriza okwesiga Omwana wo, era nkwebaza.
Njatula nti emirundi mingi ngezezzaako okuzaala ebibala olw’okwefuba, ne nkoowa era ne nswala. Njigiriza mu kifo ky’ekyo okubeera mu ggwe, okunywa ku mugga gw’Omwoyo wo, n’okukuleka ozaale ebibala mu nze mu ntuuko zaabyo.
Abantu bo bwe banaasanganga ensozi, tuwe okukkiriza olw’essaawa eyo, era kireetere ggwe wekka ekitiibwa.
Ggwe eyatandika okukkiriza kwange era akutuukiriza, maliriza kye watandika mu nze. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Bika ki ebisatu eby’okukkiriza Evans by’asanga mu Byawandiikibwa?
study_questions.answer: Okukkiriza okulokola, kwe tuweebwa obutuukirivu ne tuyingizibwa mu maka ga Katonda; ekibala ky’okukkiriza, ekimu ku bibala by’Omwoyo mu Abaggalatiya 5; n’ekirabo ky’okukkiriza, ekimu ku birabo by’Omwoyo mu 1 Abakkolinso 12, ekiweebwa olw’embeera emu olw’obulungi bw’omubiri gwonna.

study_questions.question: Evans asoma atya ebigambo bya Yokaana eri abaana abato, abavubuka n’abakulu?
study_questions.answer: Ng’emitendera gy’okukula, so si myaka. Omwana omuto amanyi nti ebibi bye bisonyiyiddwa era asobola okuyita Katonda Kitaffe, omuvubuka wa maanyi ng’Ekigambo kibeera mu ye era awangula omubi, n’omukulu atuuse okumanya oyo eyaliwo okuva ku lubereberye; okukkiriza okulokola “gwe mulyango, so si nnyumba.”

study_questions.question: Emboozi ya Evans gy’akkiriza nti yagiyiiya, ey’omuti gwa apo ogusinda, egendererwamu ki?
study_questions.answer: Emiti tegizaala bibala lwa kwekaka, naye abakkiriza bangi balowooza nti ekibala ky’Omwoyo kijja nga bafuba nnyo. Omuti gubala ebibala nga guyimirira Katonda we yagusimba era nga gusika amazzi okuva mu ttaka, era bwe kityo ekibala ky’okukkiriza kikula mpola mu mukkiriza abeera mu Kristo; eyo y’ensonga lwaki Evans abuulirira okutunuulira Omuzabbibu mu kifo ky’okwekebejja amatabi gaffe buli kiseera.

study_questions.question: Evans annyonnyola atya ekirabo ky’okukkiriza?
study_questions.answer: N’olukiiko lw’ekkanisa olwasattulukana nga lukubaganya ebirowoozo ku mukozi w’abavubuka gwe lwali terusobola kusasula, omu ku bakiise eyali ayingidde ng’akiwakanya n’azuula nti waliwo ekikyuse era n’amanya nti Mukama ali mu nsonga eyo, era mu ddakiika ntono bonna ne bakkiriziganya. Era anyumya ku mukwano gwe omuvubuka mu Wales eyalina okunaanuuka okw’amaanyi eyapangisa ekisenge okubuulira ab’ekibuga kye Kristo kye yali amukoledde, n’ayogera bulungi omulundi ogwasooka mu bulamu bwe.

study_questions.question: Kiki Evans ky’aggya mu kuba nti ebika by’okukkiriza byonna ebisatu biva eri Katonda?
study_questions.answer: Nti tewali kye tuyinza kukola okweyubulira okukkiriza, n’olwekyo tewali asaanye kugamba mukkiriza omulwadde oba ali mu buzibu nti abe n’okukkiriza okusingawo. Omuntu ng’oyo ky’alina okukulaakulanyamu kwe kwesiga, okwagala buli lunaku okwesigama ku Katonda n’okumugondera, era ekkubo erigasa kwe kweteeka Katonda w’agabira okukkiriza: mu Kigambo kye, mu kusaba, mu bantu be, nga tubeera mu Muzabbibu.

fields.title: Okukwata Omukono gwa Kitaffe
fields.body_html:
Kubanga nze Mukama Katonda wo akukwata ku mukono ogwa ddyo, nze nkugamba nti, Totya nze nzija kukuyamba. ISAAYA 41:13

Okukkiriza bwe kuba nga si kintu kye tweyubulira, kale kye ki? Eky’okuddamu kya Evans, ky’awa mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye, mu Amayinja ag’Okulinnyako ne mu bubaka bwe ku kukkiriza, kye kimu ku bintu by’ayigiriza ebisinga okumwawula. Okukkiriza, nga bw’akunnyonnyola, ye Katonda yennyini okukwata ku mutima gw’omuntu n’agukyusa okwolekera okwagala kwe. Okutandika bulijjo kuva eri Katonda; obuwulize obwanukula bwe bwaffe. N’olwekyo okukkiriza kulabibwa, si mu ngeri gye tukkirizaamu n’amaanyi, wabula mu ngeri gye twanukulamu.

Ekifaananyi ky’asinga okwagala okulaga kino si muzira asengula ensozi, wabula mwana muto atambula ku mabbali g’oluguudo ng’akutte omukono gwa kitaawe.

Ebyokulabirako, so si bazira

Okunnyonnyola kutandika n’ekyewuunyo. Singa wasabibwa okulonda abantu ab’omu Bayibuli okulaga okutambula mu kukkiriza, Evans bw’agamba, oyinza okulonda Danyeri, oba Eriya, oba Kalebu. Naye Pawulo, Yakobo n’omuwandiisi w’Abaebbulaniya bwe balonda ebyokulabirako byabwe, amannya ago tegaliimu. Wabula tusangamu Ibulayimu, eyagamba emirundi ebiri nti mukyala we yali mwannyina okwewonya; Saala, eyasekerera ekisuubizo kya Katonda; Yakobo, omulimba; Musa, eyali asse omuntu; era, ekisinga okwewuunyisa, Lakabu malaaya, omulimba era omulyamu w’olukwe eri ekibuga kye.

Olw’okukkiriza malaaya Lakabu, teyazikirizibwa n’abajeemu, kubanga yasembeza abakessi, n’emirembe. ABAEBBULANIYA 11:31

Abamu Abaebbulaniya 11 bagiyita essuula y’abazira b’okukkiriza. Evans talabayo bazira. Alabayo abantu ab’abulijjo, abaalina obunafu, Katonda be yakulembera mu makubo mangi ag’enjawulo okutuukiriza ebigendererwa bye. Abamu baawangula obwakabaka; abalala baasalibwamu wakati. Abamu baawona ekitala; abalala baafa nakyo. Singa okukkiriza kwali nsonga ya kukkiriza na maanyi, essuula eyo teyandibadde na makulu. Naye okukkiriza bwe kuba nga ye Katonda akola mu muntu era omuntu oyo n’amugondera, olwo erina amakulu amatuufu ddala, era kitegeeza nti buli muntu, ne bw’aba munafu atya, asobola okutandika okutambula mu kukkiriza leero.

Engeri y’emu erabika mu Njiri. Evans alaga nti Yesu yatendereza okukkiriza kw’abantu mukaaga bokka ng’ayogera amannya gaabwe oba ebyabatuukako, era nti abo be yalonda beewuunyisa kye kimu: omukulu w’abaserikale Omuruumi, omukazi eyali amaze ebbanga eddene ng’akulukuta omusaayi era nga si mulongoofu mu mateeka, maama Omukanani, Battimaayo omuzibe w’amaaso, omukazi omwonoonyi eyafuka amafuta ku bigere bye, n’omugenge Omusamaliya eyakomawo okwebaza.

Yesu bwe yawulira ebigambo ebyo n’amwewuunya nnyo, n’akyukira ekibiina ky’abantu abaali bamugoberera n’agamba nti, “Mbagamba nti sirabanga kukkiriza kunene nga kuno, wadde mu Isirayiri.” LUKKA 7:9

Waakiri basatu tebaali Bayudaaya, abawerako baali si balongoofu, era bonna baali boonoonyi. Kye baalina bonna, Evans bw’annyonnyola, kwe kuba nti buli omu yanukula mu buwulize obujulirwa obw’omunda: omukulu w’abaserikale yategeera obuyinza bwa Yesu, omukazi yagolola omukono okukwata ku kyambalo kye newaakubadde nga tewali yamuyigiriza kukikola, omukazi Omukanani ne Battimaayo baamulaba ng’Omwana wa Dawudi, omugenge n’akomawo okusinza. Mu buli mbeera, bw’agamba, okukkiriza kwalabikira era ne kutuukirizibwa mu buwulize.

Okubikkulirwa, olwo obuwulize

Evans ensengeka y’emu agisanga mu kwatula okukulu okwa Peetero e Kayisaliya ekya Firipo. Yesu agamba Peetero nti omubiri n’omusaayi si bye bimubikkulidde Kristo kyali, wabula Kitaffe ali mu ggulu. Okubikkulirwa kusooka, nga kuva eri Katonda; olwo okwatula n’obuwulize ne bigoberera. Olwazi Kristo kw’azimba ekkanisa ye, Evans bw’alowooza, si mbeera ya Peetero ey’okwanguyiriza, wabula okukkiriza okw’engeri eno: Katonda okutandika, omuntu n’amwanukula.

Nuuwa kye kyokulabirako ekisinga okutegeerekeka mu Ndagaano Enkadde. Tekyali kizibu kukkiriza Katonda bwe yayogera; ekyafuula Nuuwa omuntu w’okukkiriza kwe kuba nti yakola byonna Katonda bye yamulagira, ng’azimba eryato olw’amataba ge yali talabangako.

Nuuwa n’akola byonna nga Katonda bwe yamulagira. OLUBEREBERYE 6:22

Ne Ibulayimu bw’atyo, yafuluma nga tamanyi gy’agenda. Teyakaayana wadde okuteesa. Yagondera.

Omukono gwa Kitaffe

Wano ekifaananyi kya Evans eky’omwana we kiyingirira. Okutambula mu kukkiriza, bw’agamba, kwe kwewaayo buli lunaku eri okwagala kwa Katonda, ebyo by’abikkulidde mu Byawandiikibwa n’ebyo by’atannatubikkulira. Ye mwana muto asigala ng’akutte omukono gwa kitaawe. Omwana tamanyi obanga olugendo lwa leero lunaakoma ku dduuka ly’obuswiiti oba ku musawo w’amannyo. Evans ayongerako, ng’amwenya, nti bwe tunaagendanga emirundi mingi ku dduuka ly’obuswiiti ery’obulamu, Kitaffe ddala ajja kuba alina okututwala ku musawo w’amannyo oluusi. Oluusi omupiira gubuukira mu luguudo, omwana n’ata omukono n’agugoberera, akabi akanene ne kajja nga kamwolekera. Naye ng’akabi tekannatuuka, Kitaffe aba amaze dda okuzza omwana ku mabbali g’oluguudo. Si kukwata kw’omwana okumulokola, wabula okwa Kitaffe.

Newaakubadde ebyo biri bwe bityo naye ndi naawe bulijjo; gw’onkwata ku mukono gwange ogwa ddyo. Mu kuteesa kwo onkulembera, era olintuusa mu kitiibwa. ZABBULI 73:23–24

Kino kye kirowoozo ekiri emabega w’erinnya ly’ekitabo kye ku kukkiriza. Ebiseera eby’omu maaso bitukwekeddwa, Evans bw’agamba mu ngeri nnyingi ne mu bifo bingi, naye Oyo akutte ebiseera eby’omu maaso tatukwekeddwa, era akutte omukono gwaffe.

Evans era ekirowoozo kino akisanga mu lunyiriri lw’ayagala ennyo, Abaggalatiya 2:20, Bayibuli ey’Olungereza eya King James w’eyogera ku kubeera omulamu olw’okukkiriza kw’Omwana wa Katonda. Agamba nti eyo y’engeri entuufu ey’okuvvuunula, era nti Pawulo ategeeza nti omukkiriza abeera mulamu lwa kukkiriza kwa Kristo yennyini okukolera mu ye, so si lwa kukkiriza kwe ye kwokka mu Kristo. Bayibuli ey’Oluganda gye tujuliza egoberera okusoma okulala, okw’okukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda. Abayivu ddala bayawukana ku ngeri y’okuvvuunula ebigambo bya Pawulo bino, era engeri zombi zirina ebyafaayo ebiwanvu; omusomi teyeetaaga kusalawo nsonga eyo okufuna amazima Evans g’agiggyamu, agayigirizibwa mu lwatu awalala. Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo ye Kristo abeera mu ffe.

Nakomererwa wamu ne Kristo, kyokka ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze; era obulamu bwe nnina kaakano mu mubiri, mbulina lwa kukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo yekka ku lwange. ABAGGALATIYA 2:20

Okukkiriza n’ebikolwa nga bitabagana

Okutegeera okukkiriza mu ngeri eno era, eri Evans, kumalawo okukontana okw’edda wakati wa Pawulo ne Yakobo. Alaga nti Luther yamanyika nnyo olw’okwogera ku Yakobo n’okumunyooma. Naye okukkiriza bwe kuba nga mutima ogugondera okukola kwa Katonda, olwo Yakobo agamba bugambi nti awatali buwulize tewali kukkiriza; kufu. Pawulo agamba nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu lwa kukkiriza, so si lwa bikolwa by’amateeka; Yakobo agamba nti okukkiriza okulamu bulijjo kweyoleka mu bye tukola. Byombi bya mazima.

Noolwekyo n’okukkiriza bwe kutyo; bwe kutabaako bikolwa kuba kufu. YAKOBO 2:17

Abawombeefu era abagonvu

Evans bino byonna abigatta ku bawombeefu, Yesu be yayita ab’omukisa. Obuwombeefu si bunafu wabula kwagala kuyigirizibwa, ebbumba eriwulira omukono gw’omubumbi. Ogwo gwe mulimu gw’okukkiriza: omutima ogukwatagana ennyo ne Katonda ne gukola nga ye bw’akola. Tayogera ku kuwulira maloboozi; ebiseera ebisinga Kitaffe akulembera mu kasirise, ng’ayita mu Byawandiikibwa, mu mbeera, ne mu bujulirwa obw’omunda obw’Omwoyo we, ng’essuula eddako bw’egenda okunnyonnyola.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Soma Abaebbulaniya 11 omulundi gumu era owandiike ebyo abantu aboogerwako mwe baagwa. Olukalala olwo lukuzzeemu amaanyi nti Katonda naawe asobola okukukulembera.

2. Weebuuze kaakano wa Katonda w’akulaze mu lwatu okwagala kwe naye nga tonnagondera. Kwata eddaala limu ery’obuwulize wiiki eno.

3. Weefaananyirize ng’omwana akutte omukono gwa Kitaffe. Wa w’okemebwa okuta omukono n’ogoberera ekintu ekisomoka oluguudo? Kyogere mu maaso ge.

4. Bw’oba olina okweraliikirira ku nkya, wandiika ekintu kimu ekikweraliikiriza era okisabireko, ng’omukono ogukikutte ogukwasa Kitaffe.

5. Lowooza obanga oyigirizika. Buuza omuntu akumanyi obulungi obanga kyangu oba kizibu okukutereeza, era owulirize eky’okuddamu.

ESSAALA
Kitaffe, walonda abalimba, abakozi b’enkwe n’abatali ba mu nnyumba okuba ebyokulabirako by’okukkiriza, era nange onnonze. Nkwebaza olw’okukulembera abantu ab’abulijjo.
Mpa omutima omuwombeefu era oguyigirizika, omugonvu mu mikono gyo, ogwanguwa okugondera bw’okola.
Bwe nta omukono gwo ne ndiruka okugoberera ebintu ebimasamasa, nzizaayo nga sinnabetentebwa, era onsonyiwe.
Ennaku zange ez’omu maaso zinkwekeddwa, naye tezikukwekeddwa ggwe. Kwata omukono gwange leero. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Evans annyonnyola atya okukkiriza mu ssuula eno?
study_questions.answer: Nga Katonda yennyini okukwata ku mutima gw’omuntu n’agukyusa okwolekera okwagala kwe. Okutandika bulijjo kuva eri Katonda era obuwulize obwanukula bwe bwaffe, n’olwekyo okukkiriza kulabibwa si mu ngeri gye tukkirizaamu n’amaanyi wabula mu ngeri gye twanukulamu.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans talaba bazira mu Abaebbulaniya 11?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga abantu aboogerwako eyo ba bulijjo era baalina obunafu: Ibulayimu yagamba nti mukyala we yali mwannyina, Saala yasekerera ekisuubizo kya Katonda, Yakobo yalimba, Musa yali asse omuntu, ate Lakabu yali malaaya, omulimba era omulyamu w’olukwe. Abamu baawangula ate abalala baasalibwamu wakati, ekintu ekiba n’amakulu singa okukkiriza ye Katonda akola mu muntu era omuntu oyo n’amugondera, n’olwekyo buli muntu, ne bw’aba munafu atya, asobola okutandika okutambula mu kukkiriza.

study_questions.question: Abantu omukaaga Yesu be yatendereza olw’okukkiriza kwabwe baafaanaganira ku ki, okusinziira ku Evans?
study_questions.answer: Baali ba kwewuunyisa: abawerako tebaali Bayudaaya oba baali si balongoofu, era bonna baali boonoonyi. Kye baafaanaganya kwe kuba nti buli omu yanukula mu buwulize obujulirwa obw’omunda, ng’omukulu w’abaserikale bwe yategeera obuyinza bwa Yesu oba omugenge bwe yakomawo okusinza; mu buli mbeera okukkiriza kwalabikira era ne kutuukirizibwa mu buwulize.

study_questions.question: Ekifaananyi kya Evans eky’omwana akutte omukono gwa kitaawe kiyigiriza ki ku kutambula mu kukkiriza?
study_questions.answer: Okutambula mu kukkiriza kwe kwewaayo buli lunaku eri okwagala kwa Katonda, okubikkuliddwa n’okutannabikkulwa, ng’omwana atamanyi obanga olugendo lunaakoma ku dduuka ly’obuswiiti oba ku musawo w’amannyo. Omwana bw’ata omukono n’agoberera omupiira mu luguudo, Kitaffe amuzzaayo ng’akabi tekannatuuka, kubanga si kukwata kw’omwana okumulokola wabula okwa Kitaffe.

study_questions.question: Okutegeera kwa Evans ku kukkiriza kutabaganya kutya Pawulo ne Yakobo?
study_questions.answer: Okukkiriza bwe kuba nga mutima ogugondera okukola kwa Katonda, olwo Yakobo agamba bugambi nti awatali buwulize tewali kukkiriza, kubanga kufu. Pawulo agamba nti tuweebwa obutuukirivu lwa kukkiriza so si lwa bikolwa by’amateeka, ate Yakobo agamba nti okukkiriza okulamu bulijjo kweyoleka mu bye tukola; byombi bya mazima.

fields.title: Essuubi ly’Okuyitibwa Kwe
fields.body_html:
Essuubi eryo lye linywereza ddala emmeeme zaffe ng’ennanga bw’enyweza eryato. Essuubi eryo lituyingiza munda w’eggigi. ABAEBBULANIYA 6:19

Evans mukakafu nti ekkanisa eyogera kitono nnyo ku ssuubi. Ekyo akyogera mu Okuliira ku Mmeeza, mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye ne mu lunyiriri lw’obubaka ku kusaba kwa Pawulo mu Abaefeso 1. Okukkiriza kubuulirwako buli kiseera, n’okwagala waakiri oluusi, naye essuubi, ery’okusatu ku mayinja ag’omuwendo amasatu amakulu aga Pawulo, terimala kuweebwa kifo kyalyo. Evans alowooza nti amanyi ensonga. Tukkirizza endowooza y’ensi ku ssuubi okudda mu kifo ky’eya Bayibuli.

Essuubi ly’ensi n’ery’Omukristaayo

Mu Lungereza olw’abulijjo, Evans bw’alaga, ekigambo ekitegeeza essuubi bulijjo kiba n’ekisiikirize ky’okubuusabuusa. Tusuubira nti enkya enkuba tegenda kutonnya, naye eyinza okutonnya. Omuyizi asuubira okuyita ebigezo bye, naye ayinza okugwa. Tusiibula abagole ku lunaku lw’embaga yaabwe ne tusuubira nti bajja kusanyuka, nga tumanyi nti obufumbo oluusi bumenyeka. Ekigambo kyogera ku kwagala okulimu obusobozi bw’okuggwamu essuubi.

Essuubi ly’Omukristaayo, bw’akakkatira, teririna kisiikirize ng’ekyo. Alinnyonnyola ng’okulindirira n’okwegomba ekintu ekikakafu dda. Omwana alindirira ekirabo ky’amazaalibwa kye kifaananyi ky’asinga okwagala: omwana tamanyi kiri mu kipapula, naye tabuusabuusa n’akatono nti ekirabo kijja. Okulindirira kujjudde okwegomba, so si kweraliikirira.

Era essuubi teritukwasa nsonyi kubanga Katonda atuwadde Mwoyo Mutukuvu ajjuza emitima gyaffe okwagala kwe. ABARUUMI 5:5

Essuubi ery’engeri eyo terikwasa nsonyi, kubanga teryesigamye ku bye twagala ffe, wabula ku bisuubizo bya Katonda ne ku ebyo by’amaze okukola.

Pawulo awozesebwa olw’essuubi

Ekyokulabirako ky’essuubi Evans ky’asinga okwagala ye Pawulo ng’ayimiridde mu maaso g’abaamasaza ne bakabaka. Bwe yaleetebwa mu maaso g’olukiiko lw’Abayudaaya, mu maaso ga Ferikisi n’oluvannyuma mu maaso ga Agulipa, omutume teyeewozaako okusinga ng’omuntu akkiriza enjigiriza ezimu. Agamba nti awozesebwa olw’essuubi ly’okuzuukira.

Kaakano nnyimiridde nga nvunaanibwa, kubanga nnina essuubi mu ebyo Katonda bye yasuubiza bajjajjaffe. EBIKOLWA BY’ABATUME 26:6

Pawulo teyali agamba, Evans bw’alaga, nti yali asuubira nti oboolyawo waliwo okuzuukira era nti teyali yasuula bwereere omulimu ogwalina ebiseera eby’omu maaso ebirungi. Yali agamba nti yali amanyi. Essuubi lye lyali bukakafu obunywevu, era lyamufuula omuvumu mu maaso g’abantu abaali basobola okumussa.

Obukakafu obwo bwesigamye ku kuzuukira kwa Kristo. Mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye Evans alambika, mu ngeri entegeke ey’omusomesa, lwaki atwala okuzuukira ng’ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okukakasibwa obujulirwa mu byafaayo: entaana enkalu, okulabikira abajulirwa bangi omulundi gumu, n’abatume okwagala okufa okusinga okwegaana kye baali balabye. Essuubi ly’Omukristaayo lyonna, bw’agamba, liyimirira oba ligwa ku kintu ekyo kimu. Akisanga nga kirabikirako ne mu byafaayo ebimpi ebya Enoka, eyatambula ne Katonda n’ataddayo kulabika, kubanga Katonda yamutwala.

Katonda Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo atenderezebwe. Olw’okusaasira kwe okungi twazaalibwa mu bulamu obulina essuubi omulundi ogwokubiri, olw’okuzuukira kwa Yesu Kristo mu bafu. 1 PEETERO 1:3

Enkufiira ey’ebirowoozo

Nga essuula ey’okusatu bwe yalaga, Evans ayawula essuubi n’okukkiriza ng’essuubi aliteeka mu birowoozo. Okukkiriza n’okwagala kye kyomu kifuba ekibikka omutima; essuubi y’enkufiira ku mutwe. Essuubi, bw’agamba, lyeyoleka mu bwesige. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki aligatta n’okukubiriza okuli mu Abaebbulaniya obutaleka buvumu bwaffe:

Kale munywererenga ku buvumu bwammwe bwe mulina, obuliko empeera ennene. ABAEBBULANIYA 10:35

Abakkiriza bangi, Evans bw’alaba, babulwa obwesige buno ddala. Tebakakasa bulokozi bwabwe, beeraliikirira engeri gye bayimiriddemu mu maaso ga Katonda, tebamanyi obanga eggulu ddala lyabwe. Ayagala basobole okugamba, nga bw’ayagala okukyogera, nti bamanyi awatali kubuusabuusa kwonna. Alaga ekigendererwa kya Yokaana mu kuwandiika ebbaluwa ye esooka: abo abakkiriza erinnya ly’Omwana wa Katonda bamanye nti balina obulamu obutaggwaawo. Obukakafu bw’Omukristaayo si kwetulinkiriza. Kye kibala ekituufu eky’essuubi.

Enjawulo y’emu agikozesa, nga bwe twalaba, ku kuyigiriza kungi okw’omulembe guno okukwata ku kwetwalira ebisuubizo. Omukkiriza bw’alangirira nti Katonda yayogera ekintu era n’olwekyo kijja kutuukirira ddala, Evans bw’alowooza, omukkiriza oyo aba akozesa essuubi, era tewali kibi mu ekyo kasita kiyitibwa erinnya lyakyo ettuufu era nga kyesigamye ku bisuubizo ebikwatako ddala. Okutabulwa kujja obwesige buno obw’ebirowoozo bwe buyitibwa okukkiriza ne bukozesebwa ng’ekyuma eky’okusika Katonda.

Kye tusuubira

Kale, Omukristaayo asuubira ki? Eky’okuddamu kya Evans, ky’aggya mu kusaba kwa Pawulo mu Abaefeso 1, kiwuniikiriza. Tusuubira okuzuukira n’okubeera ne Kristo. Naye era tusuubira okunyumirwa mu bujjuvu obusika obunene ennyo Pawulo bw’asobola okuyita obutanoonyezeka.

Nnyongera okubasabira, amaaso g’emitima gyammwe gamulisibwenga, mulyoke mumanye essuubi ly’okuyitibwa kwammwe, n’obugagga obungi bwe mulina mu ye, mmwe awamu n’abantu ba Katonda bonna. ABAEFESO 1:18

Mu bubaka ku lunyiriri luno, Evans abuuza Kristo yennyini kiki ky’asikidde: erinnya erisinga amannya gonna, ebisumuluzo by’okufa n’emagombe, entebe ey’obwakabaka, n’okusinza okw’omu ggulu. Olwo n’ayongerako nti obusika bwa Kristo tebunnaggwa. Bulituukirizibwa mu mugole we, ekkanisa, abatukuvu. Mu Lungereza lwa King James olunyiriri lwogera ku busika bwe mu batukuvu, era ku ekyo kw’azimba: ffe tuli kitundu ku busika bwe, era tuli basika wamu naye ku byonna ebibye. Omwoyo gwe twaweebwa kaakano gwe musingo, ekitundu ekisooka, eky’obusika obwo.

Omwoyo yennyini akakasiza wamu n’omwoyo waffe nga bwe tuli abaana ba Katonda. Kale nga bwe tuli abaana, tuli basika ba Katonda, era tulisikira wamu ne Kristo, bwe tubonaabonera awamu naye, tulyoke tuweerwe wamu naye ekitiibwa. ABARUUMI 8:16–17

Eno y’ensonga lwaki Evans asobola okwogera ku ssuubi ng’ekintu eky’okunyumirwa kaakano so si oluvannyuma kwokka. Omukkiriza amanyi ekimulindiridde abeera mu ngeri ya njawulo leero. Ensi eno agikwata mpola, ng’abajjajja abaatula nti baali bagenyi era batambuze ku nsi. Asobola okwolekera obulwadde, okufiirwa n’obukadde n’emirembe. Evans ayogeddeko, mu kwefuga, ku kusanga obulwadde obw’amaanyi mu maka ge yennyini n’afunirayo emirembe gye yali tasobola kunnyonnyola okuggyako ng’ekirabo kya Katonda.

Okulabula n’okuzzaamu amaanyi

Omusomi omwegendereza ayinza okwagala okukwata mpola engeri Evans gy’ateeka essuubi mu birowoozo n’okukkiriza mu mutima. Ebyawandiikibwa byogera ku kukkiriza n’omutima (Abaruumi 10:10) ne ku mutima ogusuubira, era ebifaananyi by’ekyomu kifuba n’enkufiira tebigendererwa kuba maapu ya mmeeme. Naye ensonga ye enkulu ya muwendo era yeetaagibwa. Essuubi ly’Omukristaayo si kwegomba kwa bwereere. Ye nnanga esibiddwa munda w’eggigi, mu maaso ga Katonda ddala, Kristo gye yatukulemberamu.

Kaakano Katonda w’okusuubira, abajjuze essanyu lyonna n’emirembe mu kukkiriza, mulyoke mweyongerenga mu ssuubi ery’amaanyi aga Mwoyo Mutukuvu. ABARUUMI 15:13
OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Wiiki eno weetegereze emirundi gy’okozesa ekigambo essuubi nga kirimu ekisiikirize ky’okubuusabuusa. Weebuuze kyandibadde kitegeeza ki okusuubira nga Endagaano Empya bw’esuubira.

2. Wandiika Abaruumi 8:16–17 era olusome buli nkya okumala wiiki emu. Weebaze Katonda nti oli musika we.

3. Bw’oba tokakasa bulokozi bwo, soma 1 Yokaana 5:10–13 mpola era oleete okubuusabuusa kwo eri Katonda. Kwogereko n’omukkiriza akuze mu by’omwoyo.

4. Lowooza ku ky’owandyogedde singa, nga Pawulo, wasabibwa okunnyonnyola essuubi eriri mu ggwe. Wandiika eky’okuddamu ekimpi, mu bigambo ebyangu.

5. Yogera okutya kumu okw’ebiseera eby’omu maaso essuubi mu Kristo kwe likolako, era okusabire ng’okwogera erinnya.

ESSAALA
Katonda w’essuubi, wanzaala omulundi ogw’okubiri mu ssuubi eddamu olw’okuzuukira kwa Yesu Kristo mu bafu. Essuubi eryo libeere nnanga y’emmeeme yange amayengo bwe gasituka.
Zibula amaaso g’omutima gwange, ndyoke mmanye essuubi ly’okuyitibwa kwo n’obugagga bw’obusika bwo mu batukuvu.
Nkuuma nneme kuleka bwesige bwange. We nneeraliikirira engeri gye nnyimiriddemu mu maaso go, Omwoyo wo akakase wamu n’omwoyo wange nti ndi mwana wo.
Njjuza essanyu n’emirembe mu kukkiriza, okutuusa lwe ndiraba amaaso go. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Essuubi ly’Omukristaayo lyawukana litya ku ssuubi ery’abulijjo mu Lungereza, okusinziira ku Evans?
study_questions.answer: Essuubi ery’abulijjo bulijjo liba n’ekisiikirize ky’okubuusabuusa, kwe kwagala okuyinza okuggwamu essuubi. Essuubi ly’Omukristaayo teririna kisiikirize ng’ekyo; kwe kulindirira n’okwegomba ekintu ekikakafu dda, ng’omwana alindirira ekirabo ky’amazaalibwa atamanyi kiri mu kipapula naye atabuusabuusa nti ekirabo kijja.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans alaga okuwozesebwa kwa Pawulo mu maaso g’olukiiko, Ferikisi ne Agulipa?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga Pawulo yagamba nti yali awozesebwa olw’essuubi ly’okuzuukira, era teyategeeza nti yali asuubira bususuubizi nti oboolyawo waliwo okuzuukira; yali amanyi. Essuubi lye lyali bukakafu obunywevu, era lyamufuula omuvumu mu maaso g’abantu abaali basobola okumussa.

study_questions.question: Evans agamba nti essuubi ly’Omukristaayo lyonna lyesigamye ku ki, era lwaki alitwala ng’ekyesigika?
study_questions.answer: Ku kuzuukira kwa Kristo, essuubi ly’Omukristaayo kwe liyimirira oba kwe ligwa. Akutwala ng’ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okukakasibwa obujulirwa mu byafaayo olw’entaana enkalu, okulabikira abajulirwa bangi omulundi gumu, n’abatume okwagala okufa okusinga okwegaana kye baali balabye.

study_questions.question: Evans, ng’abuulira ku Abaefeso 1:18, ayogera ki ku busika bwa Kristo n’omugabo gw’omukkiriza mu bwo?
study_questions.answer: Kristo yasikira erinnya erisinga amannya gonna, ebisumuluzo by’okufa n’emagombe, entebe ey’obwakabaka n’okusinza okw’omu ggulu, naye obusika bwe tebunnaggwa; bulituukirizibwa mu mugole we, ekkanisa. Ffe tuli kitundu ku busika bwe era tuli basika wamu naye, era Omwoyo gwe twaweebwa kaakano gwe musingo, ekitundu ekisooka, eky’obusika obwo.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans agatta essuubi n’obukakafu bw’obulokozi?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga essuubi lyeyoleka mu bwesige, era abakkiriza bangi babulwa obwesige obwo ddala, nga tebakakasa bulokozi bwabwe wadde engeri gye bayimiriddemu mu maaso ga Katonda. Ng’alaga ekigendererwa kya Yokaana nti abakkiriza bamanye nti balina obulamu obutaggwaawo, agamba nti obukakafu bw’Omukristaayo si kwetulinkiriza wabula kye kibala ekituufu eky’essuubi.

fields.title: Endiga Zange Zitegeera Eddoboozi Lyange
fields.body_html:
Endiga zange zitegeera eddoboozi lyange, era nzimanyi era zingoberera. YOKAANA 10:27

Okukkiriza bwe kuba nga mutima ogwanukula okukola kwa Katonda, kale omukkiriza alina okuyiga okutegeera Katonda w’akolera. Evans awaayo essuula yonna mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye ku kuwulira eddoboozi lya Katonda, era omulamwa guno guyita mu bubaka bwe. Okuyigiriza kwe wano kwa kutebenkeza n’obwegendereza. Ku ludda olumu akakasa nti Katonda ddala ayogera era nti endiga ze zisaanidde okusuubira okumuwulira. Ku ludda olulala abuusabuusa mu lwatu bingi ebiyitibwa okuwulira Katonda, era alabula ku kabi ke bireeta.

Kyandibadde kyangu singa eddoboozi liva mu kisaka?

Atandika ne Musa ku kisaka ekyaka omuliro, n’abuuza ekibuuzo ffenna kye twali tubuuzizza. Tekyandibadde kyangu okutambulira mu kwagala kwa Katonda singa yali atwogeza n’eddoboozi eriwulikika, nga bwe yayogera ne Musa? Eky’okuddamu kya Evans kyewuunyisa. Oboolyawo nedda. Singa twawulira Katonda mu lwatu bwe kityo, tetwandibadde na kyekwaso n’akatono eky’obujeemu, era obuwulize bwaffe bwandibadde bwa kutya so si bwa kwagala. Katonda, bw’agamba, tawalirizangako wadde okukozesa abantu be mu nkwe. Anoonya abantu obuwulize mwe bwafuuka empisa ey’obutonde, abagondera kubanga bamwagala era nga baagala.

Oluvannyuma lwa musisi ne wajja omuliro, naye era Mukama teyaliimu mu muliro. Oluvannyuma lw’omuliro, ne wajja eddoboozi ttono nga lya ggonjebwa. 1 BASSEKABAKA 19:12

Eyo y’ensonga lwaki ebiseera ebisinga ayogera, si mu mbuyaga, musisi oba omuliro, wabula mu ddoboozi ettono erya ggonjebwa eriyinza okuwulirwa emmeeme yokka ekwatagana naye. Eriya, eyali akooye era ng’atidde, teyazzibwamu maanyi lwa kwolesebwa kwa buyinza, wabula olw’eddoboozi eryo ery’akasirise. Evans ayongera akakyuko akatono ku bigambo Yesu bye yagamba Tomasi. Yesu yasuubiza omukisa abo abakkiriza nga tebalabye; omukisa gwe gumu, Evans bw’alowooza, guli ku abo abagondera nga tebawulirangako ku Katonda mu ddoboozi eriwulikika.

Lwaki tetuwulira

Katonda bw’aba ng’ayogera, lwaki endiga ze nnyingi tezimuwulira? Eky’okuddamu kya Evans kiri nti eddoboozi lye libuutikirwa oluyoogaano lw’amaloboozi amalala. Akkiriza nti ekyo kituufu ne ku ye yennyini. Akkiriza nti Katonda ayogera naye buli lunaku, naye oluyoogaano lw’ebirowoozo bye, ebyo ensi by’emwetaagisa n’emirimu emingi egy’ekkanisa bitera okumusindika ebweru.

Ayigira, ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo eri omukkiriza w’enjiri ow’ennono gye yakuliramu, ku Bajjajja ab’omu Ddungu, abeewala Obukristaayo obwali butandise okussibwamu ekitiibwa mu nsi okunoonya Katonda mu kasirise k’eddungu. Talowooza nti tulina okufuuka abamonaaki. Naye alowooza nti tulina okuddamu okufuna kye baali bamanyi: nti okusirika, akasirise ak’omunda n’ebiseera byetaagisa bwe tuba ab’okutegeera eddoboozi lya Katonda. Katonda ayogera, bw’agamba, si okusinga eri amagezi g’omutwe wabula eri omwoyo, Omwoyo we gy’ayogeragana n’owaffe. Tekyetaagisa diguli, wabula omutima oguwuliriza.

Musiriikirire mutegeere nga nze Katonda. Nnaagulumizibwanga mu mawanga. Nnaagulumizibwanga mu nsi. ZABBULI 46:10

Mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye awandiika ebintu bitaano by’akkiriza nti twetaaga bwe tuba ab’okuwulira Katonda: enjala ey’okwagala kwe; omutima ogumaliridde okugondera buli ky’asaba; ebiseera mu Kigambo kye; ekifo eky’akasirise eky’okufumiitiririzaamu; n’akasirise ak’omunda n’okubeera wekka. Tewali na kimu ku byo kya kitalo. Byonna bya bbeeyi mu bulamu obujjudde emirimu.

Mukama yaŋŋambye

Naye Evans tasanyukira buli muntu agamba nti aluŋŋamiziddwa Katonda. Akkiriza nti ebintu bitono ebitabula omusumba okusinga emboozi etandika n’omuntu ng’alangirira nti Mukama amugambye ekintu, ng’olinga ekyo kimaliriza ensonga nga n’okuteesa tekunnatandika. Bw’abuuza mu bukkakkamu Mukama engeri gye yayogeddemu, eky’okuddamu, bw’agamba, kitera okuba ekirowoozo kyokka, oboolyawo ekyasituliddwa enneewulira y’olukuŋŋaana oba ekirowoozo ky’omukwano.

Alabye akabi ka ddala akavudde mu kino. Anyumya ku bannakyewa abajja okuweereza ku kyombo ky’okusaasira kubanga Mukama yali abagambye, ne bazuula mu wiiki ntono nti si we baali baagala okubeera. Ekisinga obubi, yamanya abakazi abaaleka babbaabwe abeesigwa kubanga baali bakkiriza nti Mukama yali abagambye, nga kiwakanya mu lwatu Ebyawandiikibwa. Katonda tagambangako muntu yenna kukola Kigambo kye kye kigaana.

Abaagalwa, temukkirizanga buli myoyo, naye musookenga okugyetegereza mulabe obanga givudde eri Katonda, kubanga kaakano waliwo bannabbi ab’obulimba bangi mu nsi. 1 YOKAANA 4:1

Okubuulirira kwe okw’omugaso kwangu era kwa magezi. Katonda ddala aluŋŋamya ng’ayita mu ngeri nnyingi: mu Byawandiikibwa, mu kubuulirirwa mikwano, mu birooto, mu mbeera, mu lunyiriri olweyongera okweyoleka, oba mu kwagala okw’omunda okugenda kweyongera. Bino kisinga okubitwalira wamu so si kimu kimu. Era kisinga nnyo okugamba, mu bwetoowaze, nti tukkiriza nti Mukama ayagala tukole ekintu, okusinga okulangirira nti Mukama yatugamba. Ekisooka kiyita abalala okukigezesa; eky’okubiri kiwaana ayogera era kiyinza okwonoona ennyo obwesigwa bw’enjiri.

Ekigambo mu katoozi ak’ewansi

Evans yeegendereza kye kimu ku bunnabbi. Ekirabo ekyo akitwala nga kya muwendo era akkiriza nti kya kkanisa ne leero, naye alabye abakkiriza bangi nga batabuddwa era nga balumiziddwa obunnabbi obw’omuntu kinnoomu obwaboogerwako okuva ku mikiikiro, nga tewali avunaanyizibwa nnyo bwe bwalemwa okutuukirira. Abuulira, ng’akikkiriza, okubuulirira kwe yawulira okuva eri omukulembeze mu Youth With A Mission: nti ekigambo ky’obunnabbi eky’omuntu kinnoomu kisaanye okuterekebwa, mu ngeri emu, mu katoozi akasibiddwa. Tekiweebwa kuluŋŋamya kaakano. Bwe kiba kivudde eri Katonda, olunaku lulijja, oboolyawo mu kifo ekizibu, lw’olikijjukira n’ozzibwamu amaanyi nti Katonda yalaba dda gy’agenda okukutuusa. Ekkanisa ky’esinga okwetaaga, bw’ayongerako, kye kirabo ky’okwawula.

Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era temunyoomanga abo aboogera eby’obunnabbi, naye mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:19–21

Ebiseera ebitali bya bulijjo

Evans teyefuula nti Katonda tayogeranga mu ngeri ezitali za bulijjo. Anyumya ku mirundi mitono nnyo gye yawulira ky’asobola okuyita eddoboozi eriwulikika, bulijjo mu kiseera eky’obuzito so si eky’obuwanguzi obw’omwoyo. Olumu, ku lusozi ku Vancouver Island, yagambibwa nti yali agenda kuba omusumba w’ekkanisa e Victoria; ye ne Anne tebaabuulirako muntu yenna era tebaakola kintu kyonna okukireetawo, era emyezi egyaddirira okuyitibwa ne kujja awatali akuyigiriza.

Yeegendereza okwongerako nti ebintu ng’ebyo bitono nnyo, nti tebyamufuula wa mwoyo okusingawo, era nti okwesiga kwe mu Katonda tekuzimbiddwa ku byo. Kuzimbiddwa ku bukakafu obwa buli lunaku nti Katonda amukulembera nga bw’asigala ng’akutte omukono gwe.

Okuwuliriza wamu

Ekitundu ky’enjigiriza ya Evans ku mulamwa guno ekisinga okumwawula kikwata ku kuwuliriza ng’ekkanisa. Anyumya ku nkuŋŋaana z’okusaba ekibinja mwe kyasomanga zabbuli, ne balindirira mu kasirise okumala ekiseera ekigere, olwo ne bagabana ebirowoozo, ebifaananyi oba ebyawandiikibwa ebyabajjidde mu birowoozo, nga tebagezaako kubinnyonnyola. Yalaba ensengeka nga zeeyoleka ezitaali zirabiddwa muntu yenna ku bo kinnoomu, n’ayiga okusaba nga bw’ekyetaagisa. Mu mboozi emu gy’anyumya mu bifo ebiwerako, ekibiina ekitono kyasanga ebirowoozo byabwe nga byolekera gavumenti, abantu ab’ennono abaasooka mu Canada, n’ekyombo ekyeru, ne bazuula ddakiika ntono oluvannyuma, okuva eri omugenyi eyali mu kisenge, nti waliwo ekyombo ekyali kigenda okugulwa olw’obuweereza obw’engeri eyo ddala. Baakisaba okutuusa lwe kyabaawo.

Era ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera. MATAYO 18:19

Evans ky’ayigiramu si nti buli kibinja kijja kufuna obukakafu obw’ekitalo bwe butyo, wabula nti Katonda asanyuka okumanyisa omutima gwe abantu abamulindirira nga bali wamu, era nti mu bangi mulimu obukuumi. Okuluŋŋamizibwa okugezesebwa mu bakkiriza abeetoowaze tekutera kubula nga okuluŋŋamizibwa omuntu kw’ayogerako ng’ali yekka.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Wiiki eno teekawo eddakiika kkumi n’ettaano ez’okutuula mu kasirise ne zabbuli, ng’osaba Mukama ayogere. Wandiika kyonna ekikujjira mu birowoozo, era okigezese n’Ebyawandiikibwa.

2. Ddamu weetegereze ebyetaago bya Evans ebitaano: enjala ey’okwagala kwa Katonda, omutima ogumaliridde okugondera, ebiseera mu Kigambo, ekifo eky’akasirise, n’akasirise ak’omunda. Kiki ekisinga obunafu mu bulamu bwo? Kola enkyukakyuka emu.

3. Bw’oba wali ogambye nti Mukama yakugamba ekintu ate ne kizuulibwa nti kyali kikyamu, kireete gy’ali awatali nsonyi era okiyigireko.

4. Omulundi oguddako bw’onoowulira Katonda ng’akukulembera, kyogereko mu bwetoowaze era oyite omukkiriza akuze mu by’omwoyo akipime naawe.

5. Weereza ekirowoozo eri ekibinja kyo ekitono oba olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olw’ebiseera eby’okulindirira Katonda mu kasirise, nga biddirirwa okugabana n’okusaba.

ESSAALA
Omusumba Omulungi, wagamba nti endiga zo ziwulira eddoboozi lyo. Onsonyiwe olw’okuleka amaloboozi amalala amangi okubuutikira eriryo.
Njigiriza okusirika, okulindirira n’okuwuliriza. Mpa omutima ogwagala okwagala kwo okusinga okwagala kwagwo, n’omwoyo ogukwatagana n’ogwo.
Nkuuma nneme kutwala birowoozo byange ng’ekigambo kyo, era nneme kukozesa linnya lyo okuwolereza ekyo Ekigambo kyo kye kigaana.
Yogera, Ayi Mukama kubanga omuweereza wo awulira. Era mpa ekisa okugondera. Amiina.
