fields.title: Amayinja ag’Okulinnyako
fields.body_html:
Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula. ENGERO 3:5–6

Amayinja ag’Okulinnyako byafaayo bya Evans yennyini, naye era kitabo kya kuyigiriza. Yakiwandiika, bw’annyonnyola ku ntandikwa, si lwa kunyumya bunyumya bulamu, wabula okwanjulira abasomi Katonda akulembera abaana be, ddaala ku ddaala, mu kutambula naye okw’oku lusegere. Bw’atunuulira emabega ku bulamu bwe, alaba olunyiriri lw’ebifo, buli kimu nga kifo Katonda we yayingirira enteekateeka ze, buli kimu nga kituusa ku kiddako. Okuva mu kulaba okwo okw’ewala, aggyamu enjigiriza ku kuluŋŋamizibwa ey’ebbugumu, ey’omugaso, era eri abakkiriza bangi abeeraliikirivu, esumulula nnyo.

Tewali pulaani ekwekeddwa

Omutima gwayo mwangu. Evans takkiriza nti Katonda akuuma okwagala kwe ku bulamu bwaffe mu pulaani ey’ekyama eterekeddwa mu ggulu, gye tulina okuvvuunula olw’essaawa nnyingi ez’okusaba nga tweraliikirira, nga tutya okugisubwa ne tufiirwa ekisa kye. Kitaffe ow’okwagala, bw’akakkatira, tabonyaabonya baana be ng’abakweka ky’abaagaliza. Asuubira tutambulire mu kwagala kw’amaze okubikkula mu Byawandiikibwa, era atukulembera mu kwagala kwe okw’enjawulo ku bulamu bwaffe ng’ayita mu mbeera ne mu nzigi z’aggulawo n’z’aggalawo mu maaso gaffe.

Mukama bw’asanyukira ekkubo ly’omuntu, aluŋŋamya entambula ye. ZABBULI 37:23

N’olwekyo, ekyaffe si kunoonya kkubo likwekeddwa, wabula okusigala nga tukutte omukono gwe n’okutambula mu buwulize eri bye tumanyi dda. Evans endowooza ye agifunza mu ssaala gy’abadde asaba, bw’agamba, okumala ebbanga eddene ery’obulamu bwe ng’omuntu omukulu: ng’asaba akuumibwe mu kwagala kwa Katonda okutuusa ku nkomerero y’olugendo, ng’akkiriza nti oluusi ajja kukuvaamu, era ng’ayita Katonda amuzzeeyo buli lw’anaakuvaamu. Tasaba maapu ya kkubo, wabula okukuumibwa mu lyo.

Okuggwaamu essuubi n’enteekateeka za Katonda

Ekisinga okwawula ekitabo kino y’engeri Evans gy’asomamu ebyamuggwaamu essuubi. Emirundi n’emirundi oluggi lwe yali asuubira okuggulwawo lwamuggalirwa mu maaso. Omulimu gw’okusomesa mu Canada gwamuweebwa ate ne guggyibwawo ku ssaawa esembayo, ne gumuleka ng’aswadde mu maaso ga mikwano gye be yali ayogedde nabo mu lwatu ku bulungi bwa Katonda. Enteekateeka ey’okusenguka okugenda e California yasattulukana enkola ya gavumenti bwe yakyuka. Okusaba olukusa okusoma diguli ey’okubiri kwagaanibwa.

Emyaka mingi oluvannyuma lwe yasobola okulaba Katonda kye yali akola. Omulimu ogwaggyibwawo gwamutwala e Hong Kong ne mu mikwano egyabumba ebiseera bye eby’omu maaso; okugwa kw’enteekateeka ezaddirira kwamutwala, ddaala ku ddaala, ku ssomero ly’Abayudaaya e Toronto gye yaweebwa eddembe eritali lya bulijjo okwogera ku Kristo, era okuva eyo n’agenda mu busumba. Okusisinkana okw’omu kigwo mu bizimbe ebikyamu, ebbaluwa emu eyatuuka ku nkya eyeetongodde, munnaggwanga eyayimiriza emmotoka ye ku mabbali g’oluguudo mu India: Evans alina emboozi nnyingi nnyo ng’ezo, era agaana okuziyita ebyagwawo obugwi. Ebyamulemesa ebyasinga okumunakuwaza, emirundi n’emirundi, byazuulibwa nga nteekateeka za Katonda yennyini.

Era tumanyi nga eri abo abaagala Katonda, era abo abayitibwa ng’okuteesa kwe bwe kuli, ebintu byonna bibatuukako olw’obulungi. ABARUUMI 8:28

Mwesimbu nti kino kulaba kwa mabega. Mu kiseera ekyo yabuuza Katonda ebibuuzo, yawulira ng’omusirusiru, era yeetaaga ebiseera okwewaayo. Kyamutwalira emyaka kkumi, mu mbeera emu, okulaba lwaki oluggi lwali luggaddwawo. Eky’okuyiga si nti abakkiriza tebasaana kuwulira nnaku ya kuggwaamu ssuubi, wabula nti basobola okwesiga omukono gwa Kitaffe ne bwe batasobola kulaba kigendererwa kye.

Okukulemberwa ng’ayita mu balala

Evans alaga nti Katonda atera okukulembera abaana be ng’ayita mu kusalawo kw’abantu abalala, ne mu abo abatamumanyi. Ibulayimu, bw’alaga mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye, yasooka kuva mu Uli eky’Abakaludaaya kubanga kitaawe Teera yasengula amaka; oluvannyuma lwe Katonda yayogera naye butereevu. Mu bulamu bwe yennyini, abakulu b’amasomero, abakungu n’omukungu w’ebyenjigiriza eyali amuziyizza, bonna baafuuka, nga tebamanyi, ebikozesebwa Katonda mu kumukulembera. Omukono gwa Kitaffe tegusalibwako kusalawo kwa bakozesa, kwa bakungu wadde kwa balabe.

Mwagenderera okunnumya, naye Katonda n’akifuula ekirungi, n’akikozesa abantu baleme okufa. OLUBEREBERYE 50:20

Okugezesebwa, so si kukemebwa

Evans ayawula n’obwegendereza okugezesebwa n’okukemebwa. Katonda tatukemanga okwonoona; ogwo mulimu gwa Setaani ng’akozesa okwegomba kwaffe ffe. Naye Katonda agezesa abaana be, si lwa kuyiga kintu, kubanga amanyi dda ekinaavaamu, wabula alyoke atulongoose. Akozesa ekifaananyi ky’amayinja ag’ebyuma mu kyokero, agabugumizibwa okutuusa ebisasiro lwe bisenebwako, ekyuma ekirongoofu ne kiraga ekifaananyi ky’amaaso g’oyo akirongoosa.

Kubanga okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza kwammwe, kwa muwendo mungi nnyo okusinga zaabu egezebwa mu muliro n’ekakasibwa, kulyoke kusaanire ettendo n’ekitiibwa n’okugulumizibwa ku lunaku luli Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo lw’alirabikirako. 1 PEETERO 1:7

Ayogera ku bika by’okugezesebwa ebiwerako. Waliwo okugezesebwa okw’okwesittazibwa, essuula ey’ekkumi n’essatu kw’egenda okwogerako. Waliwo okugezesebwa okw’oluggi oluggale. Era waliwo okugezesebwa okw’ekyo kye tusabibwa okuteeka wansi: ekirabo, enkolagana, ekintu kye tulina, wadde okuyitibwa kwennyini. Nga Ibulayimu ku lusozi Moliya, tuyinza okusabibwa okuwaayo ekyo ekisinga obuwendo gye tuli. Katonda kino akikola, Evans bw’akakkatira, si lwa kutulumya wabula okutusumulula okuva mu kwesiga ekintu kyonna ekitali ye. Era emirundi mingi, bwe tumala okuteeka ekintu wansi, tuyitibwa okukiddamu okukikwata, kaakano nga kikye. Musa yasuula wansi omuggo gwe ogw’obusumba n’agukwata nate ng’omuggo gwa Katonda.

Ebiwonvu nga ensozi tezinnajja

Oboolyawo ekigambo ekisinga okukwatagana n’enjigiriza ya Evans ku kuluŋŋamizibwa kwe kukakasa kwe nti buli ntikko y’olusozi ne Katonda etuukibwako ng’oyita mu kiwonvu. Atambudde mu biwonvu ebiwerako: obutebaka obw’ebbanga eddene obwakomya obusumba bwe obusooka e Victoria, emyaka ebiri egy’obunafu oluvannyuma lw’okulongoosebwa, obulwadde obw’amaanyi awaka. Buli mulundi, nga bw’anyumya, ettaka eriri wansi lyaddirirwa ettaka eriri waggulu, era ekiwonvu gye kyakoma okuba eky’ekizikiza, n’okulaba okuva ku ntikko eziri emitala waakyo gye kwakoma okugaziwa. Emyaka gy’ekyombo ky’okusaasira gyajja butereevu oluvannyuma lw’ekiwonvu ekisooka ku ebyo.

Newaakubadde nga ntambulira mu kiwonvu eky’ekisiikirize eky’olumbe, siritya kabi konna; kubanga ggwe oli nange. Oluga lwo n’omuggo gwo bye binsanyusa. ZABBULI 23:4

Yeegendereza obutakifuula nkola. Tewali kisuubizo nti buli nnaku ejja kunnyonnyolwa mu bulamu buno, era Abaebbulaniya 11 yennyini ekomekkereza n’abangi abaafa nga tebafunye ebyo ebyasuubizibwa. Naye omukkiriza asobola okutambula mu kiwonvu ng’amanyi nti Kitaffe atambula naye, era nti tewali kifa bwereere. Emyaka amakumi ana Musa gye yamala ng’alunda endiga mu Midiyaani, egyandirabise ng’obulamu obwonoonese eri omusajja eyatendekebwa mu lubiri lwa Falaawo, gyali kutegeka Katonda kwe yamutegeka olw’okumala emyaka amakumi ana egy’okukulembera eggwanga mu ddungu.

Ekigambo eky’okutebenkeza

Abasomi abamu, naddala abo abamanyi okubonaabona okw’ebbanga eddene okutannyonnyolwa, bayinza okusanga emboozi nnyingi eza Evans ez’ebiseera Katonda bye yategeka nga nzibu okuwulira. Si buli bulamu bw’omukkiriza nti bulimu enkyukakyuka ez’ekitalo bwe zityo, era kyandibadde kusoma bubi bitabo bye okupima okutambula kwaffe ne Katonda n’omuwendo gw’ebyewuunyisa ebigwawo obugwi mu bwo. Evans yennyini agamba nti obumanyirivu tebuteekawo njigiriza, newaakubadde nga Ebyawandiikibwa bijja kukakasibwa mu bumanyirivu. Enjigiriza etegeerekeka bulungi: Katonda aluŋŋamya entambula y’abantu be, emirundi mingi nga tekirabika, era mwesigwa mu kizikiza nga bw’ali mu kitangaala.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Wandiika enzigi bbiri oba ssatu ezaggalwawo mu bulamu bwo. Ku buli lumu, wandiika ky’osobola kaakano okulaba ku kigendererwa kya Katonda, oba, bw’oba tonnakiraba, wandiika sentensi ng’olumukwasa.

2. Lekera awo okunoonya pulaani ekwekeddwa. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, wandiika ebintu bisatu Katonda by’abikkudde mu lwatu mu Byawandiikibwa by’osaanidde okuba ng’okola kaakano, era obikole.

3. Weebuuze obanga Katonda akusaba oteeke wansi ekintu. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, kiteeke mu maaso ge mu kusaba wiiki eno.

4. Bw’oba oli mu kiwonvu, kibuulire omukkiriza omu gw’oyinza okwesiga, era omusabe atambule naawe mu kusaba.

5. Lowooza ku kusaba, mu bigambo byo, essaala esaba Katonda akukuume mu kwagala kwe era akuzzeeyo bw’owaba.

ESSAALA
Kitaffe, oluŋŋamizza entambula yange nga ndowooza nti nze nnali ngiluŋŋamya. Nkwebaza ku buli luggi lwe waggulawo ne buli luggi lwe waggala.
Onsonyiwe olw’okwekaawa ku nzigi enzigale, n’olw’okutya nti okwagala kwo kunkwekeddwa. Njigiriza okutambulira mu ekyo ky’ondaze, n’okukwesiga ku ebisigaddeyo.
Bw’onoonsabanga okuteeka wansi ekintu, mpa ekisa okukikola, n’okukiddamu okukikwata nga kyo kyokka.
Nkulembera mu biwonvu okutuuka ku nsozi z’ontegekedde, era omukono gwange gusigale mu gwo mu kkubo lyonna. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans agaana endowooza ya pulaani ekwekeddwa ku bulamu bwaffe?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga Kitaffe ow’okwagala tabonyaabonya baana be ng’abakweka ky’abaagaliza mu pulaani ey’ekyama gye balina okuvvuunula nga beeraliikirira. Asuubira tutambulire mu kwagala kw’amaze okubikkula mu Byawandiikibwa, era atukulembera mu kwagala kwe okw’enjawulo ng’ayita mu mbeera ne mu nzigi z’aggulawo n’z’aggalawo, n’olwekyo ekyaffe kwe kusigala nga tukutte omukono gwe n’okugondera bye tumanyi dda.

study_questions.question: Evans asoma atya ebyamuggwaamu essuubi n’enzigi ezaggalwawo mu bulamu bwe?
study_questions.answer: Ng’enteekateeka za Katonda yennyini: omulimu gw’okusomesa mu Canada ogwaggyibwawo gwamutwala e Hong Kong, n’enteekateeka ezaasattulukana zaamutwala ddaala ku ddaala ku ssomero ly’Abayudaaya e Toronto n’oluvannyuma mu busumba. Akkiriza nti kuno kulaba kwa mabega, kubanga mu kiseera ekyo yabuuza Katonda ebibuuzo era olumu kyamutwalira emyaka kkumi okulaba lwaki oluggi lwali luggaddwawo; eky’okuyiga kwe kwesiga omukono gwa Kitaffe ne bwe tutasobola kulaba kigendererwa kye.

study_questions.question: Evans ayawula atya okugezesebwa n’okukemebwa?
study_questions.answer: Katonda tatukemanga okwonoona; ogwo mulimu gwa Setaani ng’akozesa okwegomba kwaffe. Naye Katonda agezesa abaana be, si lwa kuyiga kinaavaamu, ky’amanyi dda, wabula alyoke atulongoose, ng’amayinja ag’ebyuma agabugumizibwa okutuusa ebisasiro lwe bisenebwako ekyuma ne kiraga ekifaananyi ky’amaaso g’oyo akirongoosa.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans agamba nti Katonda ayinza okutusaba okuteeka wansi ekintu eky’omuwendo?
study_questions.answer: Si lwa kutulumya wabula okutusumulula okuva mu kwesiga ekintu kyonna ekitali ye, nga Ibulayimu bwe yasabibwa ku lusozi Moliya. Emirundi mingi, bwe tumala okukiteeka wansi, tuyitibwa okukiddamu okukikwata nga kikye, nga Musa bwe yasuula wansi omuggo gwe ogw’obusumba n’agukwata nate ng’omuggo gwa Katonda.

study_questions.question: Evans ategeeza ki bw’agamba nti buli ntikko y’olusozi ne Katonda etuukibwako ng’oyita mu kiwonvu, era ekyo akiteerako kkomo ki?
study_questions.answer: Okuva mu biwonvu bye yennyini eby’obutebaka, obulwadde n’obunafu, azudde nti ettaka eriri wansi lyaddirirwa ettaka eriri waggulu, era ekiwonvu gye kyakoma okuba eky’ekizikiza n’okulaba okuli emitala waakyo gye kwakoma okugaziwa. Naye takifuula nkola: tewali kisuubizo nti buli nnaku ejja kunnyonnyolwa mu bulamu buno, wabula nti Kitaffe atambula naffe era tewali kifa bwereere.

fields.title: Mubeere mu Nze
fields.body_html:
Mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe. Ng’ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze. YOKAANA 15:4

Okukkiriza bwe kuba nga kuva eri Katonda, n’ekibala nga kikula so si kweyubulirwa, ekibuuzo ekyeyoleka kiri nti omukkiriza asigala atya mu kifo Katonda w’akolera. Eky’okuddamu kya Evans kye kimu Yesu kye yawa mu kiro ekyasembayo nga tannafa: mubeere mu Nze. Yabuulira ku Yokaana 15 mu bubaka bwe Okubeera mu Kristo, era omulamwa guno guyita mu Okuliira ku Mmeeza ne mu Buuka ng’Empungu.

Okuba mu ye, n’okubeera mu ye

Evans ayawula ekintu abakkiriza bangi kye bazudde nga kitangaaza. Kintu kimu okuba mu Kristo; kintu kirala okubeera mu ye. Buli mukkiriza eyazaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri ali mu Kristo, Katonda gye yamuteeka ku kukyuka era nga mukuumi mu ye. Naye Yesu yayogera emirundi n’emirundi n’abagoberezi be ku kubeera mu ye, era engeri ey’obukwakkulizo ey’ebigambo bye, bwe munywerera mu Nze, eraga nti kisoboka okuba mu Kristo nga tobeera mu ye.

Kino akinnyonnyola n’ekifaananyi eky’awaka okuva mu Okuliira ku Mmeeza. Omugenyi akyalidde amaka ge ayinza okugamba mu mazima nti atudde mu nnyumba ya Gareth. Naye okuggyako ng’akkirizza okuyitibwa okusigala, tasobola kugamba nti abeera omwo, ng’alya ku mmeeza era ng’agabana obulamu bw’ab’omu maka. Abakristaayo bangi, Evans bw’alowooza, bagenda nga badda wakati w’okubeera mu Kristo n’okubeera mu nsi. Bali ng’abantu abalina obugagga obungi obuteekeddwa mu bbanka naye ne bawangaala ng’abaavu kubanga tebabuggyangayo.

Mu bubaka ku kusomoka Yoludaani, ensonga y’emu agiggya mu byafaayo bya Isirayiri. Ebika bwe byatuuka ku nsalo y’ensi ensuubize, ebika bibiri n’ekitundu byasaba okusigala ku ludda olw’ebuvanjuba, kubanga ensi eyo yali nnungi eri ente. Baali bamanyi ebisuubizo bya Katonda naye ne basinga kwagala ddundiro eddungi. Tuyitibwa, Evans bw’agamba, si kuba nti Katonda ayingira mu ffe kyokka, wabula ffe okuyingira mu Katonda.

Omuzabbibu n’amatabi gaagwo

Evans alaga nti Yesu yalonda omuzabbibu mu bugenderevu. Mu Ndagaano Enkadde yonna, Isirayiri efaananyizibwa ng’omuzabbibu gwa Katonda, era kumpi buli lwe kifaananyi ekyo kirabika, omuzabbibu guba gulemereddwa: tegubala, gwavunda, gumenyeddwamenyeddwa.

Tukyukire, Ayi Katonda ow’Eggye, otunuulire ensi ng’osinziira mu ggulu; olabirire omuzabbibu guno. ZABBULI 80:14

Ku nsonga eyo Yesu kw’ayogerera nti, Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima. Isirayiri we yalemererwa, ye ajja kubala ebibala, n’abo ababeera mu ye bajja kubibala wamu naye. Omuzabbibu, Evans bw’alaga, gwetaaga okusalirwa ennyo, era omuti gwagwo omugonvu teguliiko kirala kye gugasa, n’olwekyo ettabi eritabala lisaanira muliro gwokka. Omuzabbibu gubaawo olw’ekigendererwa kimu: okubala ebibala.

Obubonero bw’okubeera mu ye

Okuva mu nnyiriri ezisooka eza Yokaana 15, Evans annyonnyola okubeera mu ye kye kunaategeeza mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.

Ekisooka, kitegeeza okusalirwa. Tagumiikiriza njigiriza esuubiza obuwanguzi obutasalako. Buli musajja na mukazi wa Katonda omukulu gw’asomyeko, bw’agamba, yayita mu kusalirwa kungi nga tannabala bibala. Bw’obeera mu Kristo, suubira akambe ka Kitaffe.

Buli ttabi eriri ku Nze eritabala bibala aliggyako. Naye buli ttabi eribala ebibala, alirongoosa lyeyongerenga okubala. YOKAANA 15:2

Eky’okubiri, kitegeeza okubala ebibala, naddala ekibala ky’Omwoyo, ekikula, nga bwe twalaba mu ssuula ey’okuna, si lwa kwekaka wabula lwa kusika bulamu okuva mu Muzabbibu.

Eky’okusatu, kitegeeza nti awatali ye tetuliiko kye tuyinza kukola. Evans kino akikozesa butereevu ku kkanisa. Tusobola okukolera Katonda ebintu bingi nnyo mu magezi gaffe ne mu nteekateeka zaffe, naye awatali kubeera mu ye tewaliba bibala bya lubeerera.

Eky’okuna, kitegeeza nti ebigambo bye bibeera mu ffe, Evans kye agatta n’obuwulize n’okutambula mu kukkiriza.

Eky’okutaano, kitegeeza okuddibwamu kw’okusaba. Ekisuubizo nti tuyinza okusaba kyonna kye twagala ne kitukolerwa kitabula abakkiriza bangi, kubanga essaala nnyingi zirabika ng’ezitaddiddwamu. Evans alowooza nti okubeera mu ye kusukka okusaba. Kwe kusemberera Kristo okutuusa nga tuwulira okukuba kw’omutima gwe, olwo ne tusaba ekyo ekiri dda ku mutima gwe.

Okuwulira okukuba kw’omutima gwe

Kino akinnyonnyola n’ekyamutuukako ekyakyusa obuweereza bwe. Ng’omusumba yali abuulidde ku buminsani era ng’assaamu ekitiibwa abaminsani. Awo, mu lugendo olumpi olw’okubuulira ku nnyumba y’abaana abatalina bazadde mu Mexico, n’alaba omu ku bayizi be ng’akaabira abaana, n’awulira omukozi Omumekisiko ng’amugamba, mu ngeri emu, nti eri abo abakolera eyo, emitima gimenyeka buli lunaku. Mu kaseera ako Evans yawulira ng’awulidde okukuba kw’omutima gwa Katonda, omutima ogumenyeka buli lunaku olw’ensi erumwa. Yakomawo eka ng’akyuse, okuva ku kuba omubuulizi ayogera ku buminsani okufuuka omuntu eyeenyigira mu bwo n’omutima gwe gwonna.

Ekyo, eri Evans, ge makulu agasinga obuziba ag’okubeera mu ye: okubeera ku lusegere ne Kitaffe, okuleetera Kitaffe ekitiibwa, n’okugabana okwagala kwe n’essanyu lye. Ettabi ery’omu nsiko eryayungibwa ku muzabbibu ogw’amazima litandika okubala ebibala, si lwa kuba nti lifuuse lya busobozi, wabula kubanga obulamu bw’Omuzabbibu bukulukutira mu lyo.

Nze muzabbibu, mmwe matabi. Buli abeera mu Nze nange ne mbeera mu ye oyo abala ebibala bingi. Kubanga awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola. YOKAANA 15:5

Mu kikoligo, era nga tubuuka

Evans okubeera mu ye akugatta n’ebifaananyi ebirala bibiri by’ayagala. Ekimu kwe kuyita kwa Yesu okusitula ekikoligo kye, ekyangu, n’omugugu gwe, ogutazitowa.

Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo. Kubanga ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa. MATAYO 11:29–30

Ekirala kye kisuubizo kya Isaaya nti abo abalindirira Mukama balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu. Evans agamba nti ekigambo ky’Olwebbulaniya ekivvuunulwa okulindirira tekyogera ku kuyisa biseera n’obugumiikiriza, wabula kirimu ekirowoozo ky’obuwuzi obulangiddwa wamu ne bufuuka omuguwa. Abo obulamu bwabwe obusibiddwa ku Mukama, bw’agamba, be babuuka. Okulindirira Katonda kwe kubeera mu Kristo nga kwambadde engoye z’Endagaano Enkadde.

Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika. ISAAYA 40:31

Kisaana okwogerwa, mu bukkakkamu, nti ensibuko eno ey’ekigambo ewakanyizibwa. Ekigambo kirina erinnya erikwatagana nakyo eritegeeza omuguwa oba olukoba, naye mu nkozesa ekikolwa kino okusinga kitegeeza okulindirira oba okutunuulira Mukama n’okwegomba, era enkyusa ezisinga obungi bwe zityo bwe zikivvuunula. Ekifaananyi ky’omuguwa kisinga kutwalibwa ng’ekyokulabirako so si ng’amakulu ag’olwatu ag’ekigambo. Naye ensonga ya Evans teyesigamye ku kyo. Ebyawandiikibwa awalala bitegeeza mu lwatu ddala nti abo abalindirira Mukama be bamwesigamako ddala, era nti amaanyi ag’olugendo gava mu kwegatta ne Kristo, so si mu kwefuba.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Weebuuze mu mazima: ndi mu Kristo kyokka, oba mbeera mu ye? Kiki ekyandikyuse wiiki eno singa osalawo okubeera mu ye?

2. Lowooza ku ekyo Kitaffe ky’ayinza okuba ng’asalira mu bulamu bwo kaakano. Mu kifo ky’okukiziyiza, buuza kibala ki ky’agenderera.

3. Ng’ekiseera kyo eky’okwegayiririra abalala ekiddako tekinnatuuka, mala eddakiika ntono ng’osirise bubeezi ne Kristo era ng’obuuza kiki ekiri ku mutima gwe.

4. Tunuulira ekitundu ky’obuweereza bwo eri Katonda ekisinga okujjula emirimu. Kikulukuta okuva mu kubeera mu ye, oba mu maanyi go ggwe? Kyogereko ne Mukama.

5. Kwata ku mutwe Yokaana 15:5 era olwogere buli lw’owulira ng’okakibwa okwolesa by’osobola.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, ggwe Muzabbibu ogw’amazima, nange ndi ttabi. Awatali ggwe siriiko kye nsobola kukola, newaakubadde nga emirundi mingi neeyisizza ng’asobola okukola bingi nnyo.
Saagala kubeera ku ludda olukyamu olw’omugga, nga nsanyukira eddundiro so nga ompise okuyingira mu ggwe. Nsembeza, era onkuume omwo.
Nsalira nga bw’oyagala. Ebigambo byo bibeere mu nze, era mpulire okukuba kw’omutima gwo olw’ensi eno emenyese.
Siba obulamu bwange ku bubwo, ndyoke nziruke ne sikoowa, era ntambule ne sizirika. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Njawulo ki Evans gy’akola wakati w’okuba mu Kristo n’okubeera mu ye?
study_questions.answer: Buli mukkiriza eyazaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri ali mu Kristo, Katonda gye yamuteeka ku kukyuka, naye ebigambo bya Yesu eby’obukwakkulizo, “bwe munywerera mu Nze”, biraga nti kisoboka okuba mu Kristo nga tobeera mu ye. Ng’omugenyi atudde mu nnyumba ya Gareth naye atakkirizangako kuyitibwa kubeera omwo, Abakristaayo bangi bagenda nga badda wakati w’okubeera mu Kristo n’okubeera mu nsi.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans alowooza nti Yesu yalonda ekifaananyi ky’omuzabbibu mu bugenderevu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga mu Ndagaano Enkadde yonna Isirayiri efaananyizibwa ng’omuzabbibu gwa Katonda, era kumpi buli mulundi guba gulemereddwa: tegubala, gwavunda, gumenyeddwamenyeddwa. Ku nsonga eyo Yesu kw’ayogerera nti “Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima”, ng’ategeeza nti Isirayiri we yalemererwa ye ajja kubala ebibala, n’abo ababeera mu ye bajja kubibala wamu naye.

study_questions.question: Bubonero ki obw’okubeera mu ye Evans bw’aggya mu nnyiriri ezisooka eza Yokaana 15?
study_questions.answer: Okusalirwa n’akambe ka Kitaffe; okubala ebibala, ekibala ky’Omwoyo ekisikibwa okuva mu Muzabbibu; okumanya nti awatali ye tetuliiko kye tuyinza kukola, ky’akozesa butereevu ku nteekateeka z’ekkanisa; ebigambo bye okubeera mu ffe, okukwatagana n’obuwulize; n’okuddibwamu kw’okusaba, okuva mu kusemberera Kristo okutuusa nga tuwulira okukuba kw’omutima gwe ne tusaba ekyo ekiri dda ku mutima gwe.

study_questions.question: Kiki ekyamutuukako mu Mexico ekyakyusa Evans okuva ku kuba omubuulizi ayogera ku buminsani okufuuka omuntu eyeenyigira mu bwo n’omutima gwe gwonna?
study_questions.answer: Ku nnyumba y’abaana abatalina bazadde yalaba omu ku bayizi be ng’akaabira abaana, n’awulira omukozi Omumekisiko ng’agamba nti eri abo abakolera eyo, emitima gimenyeka buli lunaku. Mu kaseera ako yawulira ng’awulidde okukuba kw’omutima gwa Katonda, omutima ogumenyeka buli lunaku olw’ensi erumwa.

study_questions.question: Evans agatta atya okulindirira Mukama mu Isaaya 40:31 n’okubeera mu ye, era essuula epima etya ensonga ye?
study_questions.answer: Agamba nti ekigambo ky’Olwebbulaniya ekitegeeza okulindirira kirimu ekirowoozo ky’obuwuzi obulangiddwa ne bufuuka omuguwa, n’olwekyo abo obulamu bwabwe obusibiddwa ku Mukama be babuuka, era kuno kwe kubeera mu ye nga kwambadde engoye z’Endagaano Enkadde. Essuula eraga nti ensibuko eno ey’ekigambo ewakanyizibwa era esinga kutwalibwa ng’ekyokulabirako, naye ensonga ye eyimirira nti amaanyi gava mu kwegatta ne Kristo, so si mu kwefuba.

fields.title: Okuliira ku Mmeeza
fields.body_html:
Yeebazibwe Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, atuwadde mu Kristo buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo oguva mu ggulu. ABAEFESO 1:3

Abaefeso kye kitabo kya Bayibuli Evans ky’asinga okwagala. Ekitabo kye ekimpi Okuliira ku Mmeeza kyava mu misomo gye yawa ku kitabo ekyo mu ssomero lya Bayibuli ery’omu biseera by’oluwummula e Australia, era mu bubaka bwe akomawo emirundi n’emirundi ku ssaala za Pawulo mu Abaefeso. Omutwe gw’ekitabo gulaga engeri gy’akitunuuliramu. Abaefeso mmeeza etegekeddwako emmere ennungi ennyo, era Abakristaayo abasinga obungi, bw’alowooza, kumpi tebannatandika na kulya.

Mu ye

Ebigambo ebijjuza essuula ezisooka eza Abaefeso bye bino: mu ye, oba mu Kristo. Evans abitandika n’olugero lwa Nuuwa. Nuuwa yakola nnyo okumala emyaka mingi ng’azimba eryato, naye obulokozi bwe bwasinziira ku kintu kimu: okuyingira. Tewaaliwo kununulibwa eri omuntu eyasigala ebweru ng’alaba bulabi omulimu gwe n’okwewuunya. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne Kristo. Katonda atuteereddewo ekkubo limu lyokka ery’okuwona omusango, era tulina okuyingira mu ye olw’okukkiriza.

Bwe tumala okuyingira mu ye, Katonda atulabira omwo. Kitaffe bw’atunuulira omukkiriza, Evans bw’agamba, alaba Omwana we so si kibi kyaffe; omusango gwaffe n’ensonyi zaffe bizingiddwa mu Kristo. Oluvannyuma ayita mu mikisa Pawulo gy’abala. Mu ye twalondebwa okuba abatukuvu era abataliiko kya kunenyezebwa; twafuulibwa abaana ab’obulenzi, nga tulina obwa nnannyini bwonna obw’omwana omuzaale era, bw’ayongerako, n’obukuumi omwana omuzaale bwe yali tafuna buli kiseera; twakkirizibwa mu Mwagalwa; twanunulibwa era ne tusonyiyibwa; twalagibwa ekyama ky’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala; twaweebwa obusika; era twateekebwako envumbo ey’Omwoyo Omutukuvu eyasuubizibwa.

Katonda tumutendereze olw’ekisa kye yatuwa obuwa mu Mwana, gw’ayagala ennyo. ABAEFESO 1:6

Bino byonna byaffe, Evans bw’akakasa, olw’ensonga emu yokka nti tuli mu Kristo, so si lwa kukula kwaffe wadde kwefuba kwaffe. Naye era tulina okubyetwalira. Mazima ga by’eddiini, naye eri abakkiriza bangi tegannafuuka mazima ge bawulira mu bulamu bwabwe.

Ggwe ani

Kino kikulu nnyo eri Evans kubanga obuweereza bwe obusinga obungi abumaze n’abakkiriza abatamanyi kuti bo be baani. Mu Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange awa enkalala bbiri empanvu: omukkiriza ky’ali mu Kristo, n’omukkiriza by’alina mu Kristo. Omwana wa Katonda, mukwano gwa Yesu, omusika awamu ne Kristo, ekitonde ekiggya, omutukuvu, omutuuze w’omu ggulu, omulimu gwa Katonda gwe yakola; asonyiyiddwa ddala, eyateekebwako envumbo y’Omwoyo, atuuziddwa mu bifo eby’omu ggulu, atalina musango, era asobola okutuuka ku Kitaffe butereevu. Abasomi be abawa eddagala ng’amwenya: mira ku mazima gano abiri buli lunaku era ogafumiitirizeeko, n’obusaale bw’omulabe obw’omuliro bujja kuggwaamu amaanyi.

Noolwekyo abo abali mu Kristo Yesu, tebaliiko musango; abo abatagoberera kwegomba okw’omubiri wabula ne bagoberera Omwoyo. ABARUUMI 8:1

Mu Buuka ng’Empungu kino akigatta n’obwetoowaze. Obwetoowaze, bw’agamba, si kwe kwerowoozaako bubi; obwo bwetoowaze bwa bulimba, era bulwadde ng’amalala bwe galiri. Obwetoowaze obw’amazima kwe kwelaba nga Katonda bw’akulaba, nga tozimbulukusa era nga tokendeeza ku kyo ky’akukozeemu. Abakkiriza abamanyi kye bali mu Kristo baddembe okuweereza, kubanga tebaliiko kye beetaaga kukakasa. Alaga akaseera mu Yokaana 13 Yesu bwe yali amanyi nti Kitaawe yateeka byonna mu mikono gye, era nga yava wa Katonda ate ng’adda eri Katonda, n’asituka n’anaaza ebigere by’abayigirizwa be. Okwewulira ng’oli mukuumi ye nsibuko y’obuweereza.

Okutuula, okutambula, okuyimirira

Nga Watchman Nee, eyawandiika akatabo akatono ku Abaefeso Evans ke yasoma bwe yali akyali muvubuka akulembera abavubuka mu Wales, alaba ebbaluwa eno ng’egenda mu mitendera esatu. Ogusooka, tutuuziddwa wamu ne Kristo mu bifo eby’omu ggulu. Oluvannyuma tuyitibwa okutambula mu ngeri esaanira okuyitibwa okwo. Ku nkomerero, tuyitibwa okuyimirira nga tulwanyisa omulabe.

Katonda yatuzuukiriza wamu ne Kristo okuva mu kufa ne tufuna obulamu, era atutuuzizza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu, okumpi ne Kristo Yesu. ABAEFESO 2:6

Okutuula, Evans bw’agamba, kitegeeza okulekera awo okwefuba kwaffe okusanyusa Katonda n’okuyingira mu kiwummulo kye. Okutambula kitegeeza okubeera mu bulamu obukwatagana n’ekifo ekyo: mu kwagala, mu musana, mu magezi, era nga tujjudde Omwoyo. Okuyimirira kitegeeza okwambala eby’okulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda n’okunywera mu kifo kyaffe, si nga tulwanyisa bantu wabula amaanyi ag’omwoyo agaggibwako eby’okulwanyisa ku musaalaba.

Misiri, eddungu ne Kanani

Emirundi mingi Evans akozesa olugendo lwa Isirayiri ng’ekifaananyi ky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo. Misiri bwe bulamu obutaliimu Kristo. Okusomoka Ennyanja Emmyufu, abakama ab’edda abaabakozesanga gye baasalibwako emirembe gyonna, kwe kukyuka, okukakasibwa mu kubatizibwa. Eddungu bwe bulamu bw’omukkiriza eyava mu Misiri naye nga tannayingira mu bisuubizo bya Katonda. Kanani bwe bulamu obw’ekisuubizo, obw’okuteekebwako envumbo y’Omwoyo n’okutuuzibwa wamu ne Kristo.

Akakasa nti Kanani si kifaananyi kya ggulu. Ennyimba ez’edda ezoogera ku kusomoka Yoludaani okuyingira mu nsi ya Beula zaayigiriza bangi okukisoma bwe batyo, naye Kanani yali nsi ya bawangaazi n’entalo, eya Yeriko n’ey’okuwangulwa e Ayi, era nga bw’eri ensi ey’amata n’omubisi gw’enjuki. Kifaananyi ky’obulamu Katonda bw’ateekateekedde abantu be kaakano. Bangi mu kkanisa leero, bw’alowooza, babeera mu ddungu, nga Katonda abaliisa n’obwesigwa maanu n’enkwale, era nga bamativu ddala. Katonda akyabakwatirwa ekisa. Naye yaggya Isirayiri mu Misiri asobole okubayingiza.

Naye Katonda atusuubizza olunaku olwa Ssabbiiti lwe tuliwummula, newaakubadde nga terunnatuuka. ABAEBBULANIYA 4:9

Okumumanya

Ekigendererwa ky’ebyo byonna, eri Evans, si mikisa wabula Katonda yennyini. Essaala ya Pawulo eri nti tumumanye, era Evans by’ategeeza ku kumanya bye bya Bayibuli mu bujjuvu bwabyo: okusemberera Katonda ku lusegere, okw’omuntu ku bubwe era okw’okumulaba mu bulamu, so si kumanya bumanya bigambo ebimukwatako.

Katonda wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, Kitaffe ow’ekitiibwa, abawe Omwoyo ow’amagezi n’okubikkulirwa mweyongere okumutegeera. ABAEFESO 1:17

Asomesa ekintu ekikebera omutima okuva ku Musa bwe yasaba okulaba ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Katonda yamuddamu nti amumanyi awamu n’erinnya lye, n’oluvannyuma n’alangirira erinnya lye ye, embala ye, eri Musa. Mu Byawandiikibwa, Evans bw’alaga, erinnya liraga embala. Katonda yeebikkulira, bw’alowooza, okusinziira ku by’atumanyiiko. Abuuza abasomi be erinnya Katonda ly’andibatuumye: Omubuusabuusi oba Omutiitiizi, nga mu lugero lwa Bunyan, oba Omwesigwa, Omuwanguzi. Tayigiriza nti okubikkulirwa tukukolerera. Agamba nti Katonda yeesiga n’abikkulira bingi ku ye yennyini abo abagezeseddwa ne bawangula, nga kitaawe bw’abuulira bingi omwana we omulenzi akuze.

Awo Mukama n’agamba Musa nti, “Nzija kukola ekyo kyennyini ky’osabye; onsanyusizza, era nkumanyi awamu n’erinnya lyo.” OKUVA 33:17

Ekigambo eky’okutebenkeza

Enkola ya Evans ey’emitendera, mu bbaluwa ya Yokaana ne mu lugendo lwa Isirayiri, kyokulabirako ekirungi ennyo mu kuyigiriza, era bangi kyabakubiriza okweyongerayo mu maaso. Naye kirungi okujjukira nti buli mukkiriza ali mu Kristo mu bujjuvu okuva ku lunaku olusooka, era nti obugagga bwa Abaefeso 1 bwa mutukuvu asinga obunafu nga bwe buli obw’oyo asinga amaanyi. Evans yandikkirizza. Ekigendererwa kye si kwawulamu Bakristaayo mu biti, wabula kubayita banyumirwe ekyo ekiri ekyabwe dda.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Soma Abaefeso 1:3–14 era osaze layini wansi wa buli we wasanga mu ye, mu oyo oba mu Kristo. Weebaze Katonda olwa buli mukisa ng’ogwogerako erinnya lyagwo.

2. Londa amazima abiri agakwata ku ggwe ky’oli mu Kristo era ogafumiitirizeeko buli lunaku wiiki eno, naddala bw’owulira ng’olumirizibwa.

3. Weebuuze obanga obadde obeera mu ddungu, ng’omatidde maanu. Kisuubizo ki ekya Katonda ky’otayingirangamu?

4. Lowooza obanga obuweereza bwo buva mu kwewulira ng’oli mukuumi oba mu bwetaavu bw’okwekakasa. Soma Yokaana 13:3–5 era osabe Mukama akunyweze.

5. Saba essaala ya Pawulo eri mu Abaefeso 1:17–19 ku lulwo ne ku lw’omuntu omulala ng’omwogerako erinnya buli lunaku wiiki eno.

ESSAALA
Kitaffe ow’ekitiibwa, wampa buli mukisa ogw’omwoyo mu Kristo, naye mbadde mbeera ng’omwavu ku mmeeza y’omugagga. Nsonyiwa.
Zibula amaaso g’omutima gwange ntegeere kye ndi mu Mwana wo: eyalondebwa, eyafuulibwa omwana, eyakkirizibwa, eyasonyiyibwa, eyateekebwako envumbo era eyatuuzibwa wamu naye.
Nzigya mu ddungu onyingize mu nsi ey’ekisuubizo, era ompe obuvumu okwolekera abawangaazi baayo mu maanyi go.
Okusinga byonna, ka nkumanye, era onfuule omwana ow’engeri gy’osanyukira okwebikkulira. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Evans akozesa atya olugero lwa Nuuwa okutandika ebigambo “mu ye”?
study_questions.answer: Nuuwa yakola nnyo okumala emyaka mingi ng’azimba eryato, naye obulokozi bwe bwasinziira ku kintu kimu: okuyingira, kubanga tewaaliwo kununulibwa eri omuntu eyasigala ebweru ng’awuniikirira omulimu gwe. Bwe kityo Katonda atuteereddewo ekkubo limu lyokka ery’okuwona omusango, era tulina okuyingira mu Kristo olw’okukkiriza.

Okutuula wamu ne Kristo kwe kulekera awo okwefuba kwaffe okusanyusa Katonda n’okuyingira mu kiwummulo kye; okutambula kwe kubeera mu bulamu obukwatagana n’ekifo ekyo mu kwagala, mu musana, mu magezi ne mu Mwoyo; era okuyimirira kwe kwambala eby’okulwanyisa byonna ebya Katonda nga tulwanyisa amaanyi ag’omwoyo agaggibwako eby’okulwanyisa ku musaalaba.

fields.title: Amaanyi Agava mu Ggulu
fields.body_html:
Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi. EBIKOLWA BY’ABATUME 1:8

Evans yakkiriza Kristo mu kkanisa ya Pentekoote ey’omu Wales, n’aweereza okumala emyaka mingi ng’omusumba mu Christian and Missionary Alliance, era yeeyogerako ng’omukkiriza ow’ebirabo by’Omwoyo naye omukuumi w’enjigiriza ey’edda: omuntu akkiriza nti ebirabo n’emirimu gy’Omwoyo Omutukuvu bye bimu leero nga bwe byabanga bulijjo, era nti byetaagibwa kyenkanyi. Ayogera n’ebbugumu ku ky’Omwoyo kye yafuna ng’akyali muyizi, ky’atwala ng’okukoleezebwa kw’omuliro ogwakoma okwaka okuva olwo. N’olwekyo okujjuzibwa Omwoyo kuli wakati mu njigiriza ye, mu Okuliira ku Mmeeza, mu Buuka ng’Empungu ne mu bubaka bwe Kuuma Omuliro.

Okussibwako omukka, n’oluvannyuma okuweebwa amaanyi

Evans atandikira ku njawulo eri wakati w’ebifo bibiri mu Njiri ne mu Bikolwa by’Abatume. Akawungeezi k’olunaku lw’okuzuukira, Yesu yajja eri abayigirizwa be abaali batidde mu kisenge ekisibe, n’abalaga emikono gye n’embiriizi ze, n’abassiza omukka.

Bwe yamala okwogera ebyo n’abassiza omukka, n’abagamba nti, “Mufune Mwoyo Mutukuvu.” YOKAANA 20:22

Evans akkiriza nti mu kaseera ako abayigirizwa bazaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri. Alaga engeri y’ekikolwa ky’Oluyonaani, gy’atwala ng’ekiragiro ekisuubira okutuukirira amangu ago. Naye wiiki musanvu oluvannyuma, ku Pentekoote, abayigirizwa abo bennyini bajjuzibwa Omwoyo mu maanyi. Wakati awo, Yesu yali abagambye okulindirira mu Yerusaalemi.

Laba mbaweereza ekisuubizo kya Kitange. Mubeere mu kibuga okutuusa lwe mulyambazibwa amaanyi agava mu ggulu. LUKKA 24:49

Eri Evans gino mirimu ebiri egyawukana. Ogusooka kwe kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, Omwoyo mw’atubatiriza mu mubiri gwa Kristo; ogw’okubiri kwe kubatizibwa mu Mwoyo, Mukama eyazuukira mw’awera abantu be amaanyi okuba abajulirwa. Akozesa ebigambo bibiri eby’Oluyonaani ebitegeeza amaanyi okulaga enjawulo: obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda mu Yokaana 1:12, n’amaanyi ag’okukola okuba abajulirwa mu Bikolwa by’Abatume 1:8. Atya nti abakkiriza bangi nnyo babeera mu gusooka gwokka.

Engeri y’emu agisanga mu Efeso, Pawulo gye yasanga abayigirizwa abaali bakkirizza naye nga tebawulirangako ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu, n’abassaako emikono.

N’ababuuza nti, “Bwe mwakkiriza mwafuna Mwoyo Mutukuvu?” Ne bamuddamu nti, “Nedda tetuwuliranga nti waliwo Mwoyo Mutukuvu.” EBIKOLWA BY’ABATUME 19:2

Ne Yesu yalindirira

Ensonga ye esinga okwewuunyisa agiggya mu bulamu bwa Kristo. Yesu yafunyisibwa olubuto lwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu era yali ajjudde Omwoyo okuva lwe yazaalibwa. Naye teyatandika buweereza bwe obw’olwatu okutuusa Omwoyo lwe yamukkako ku kubatizibwa kwe. Awo, mu kkuŋŋaaniro e Nazaaleesi, n’asoma mu Isaaya n’alangirira nti Ekyawandiikibwa kyali kituukiridde.

Omwoyo wa Mukama ali ku nze. Anfuseeko amafuta okubuulira abaavu Enjiri. Antumye okubuulira abasibe okuteebwa, n’abazibe b’amaaso okuzibulwa amaaso balabe, n’abanyigirizibwa okufuna eddembe. LUKKA 4:18

Obanga Yesu yeetaaga okufukibwako amafuta g’Omwoyo okukola omulimu gwe yatumibwa okukola, Evans abuuza, ffe tetusinga nnyo okugeetaaga?

Engeri y’okufunamu

Evans tayigiriza nkola ya kufunamu Mwoyo. Wabula ayogera ku kwegomba n’okwetegeka. Abayigirizwa baalindirira, era okulindirira kwabwe tekwali kwa kutuula butuuzi wabula kwali kujjudde okusaba, okusinza n’okusuubira. Ebigambo bya Yesu ku kusaba, okunoonya n’okukonkona, bw’alaga, byonna biri mu ngeri egenda mu maaso: weeyongere okusaba.

Kale obanga mmwe ababi muwa abaana bammwe ebirungi, Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisinga nnyo okubawa Mwoyo Mutukuvu abo abamusaba? LUKKA 11:13

Ayongerako nti abo abaagala okuyingira mu maaso ga Katonda balina okujja n’emikono emirongoofu n’omutima omulongoofu, era alowooza nti kyandibadde kirungi okwegezaamu embala eziraga obulamu obujjudde Omwoyo ng’engeri y’okwetegekera okubufuna.

Obubonero busatu

Embala ezo essatu ziri mu bintu ebisinga okuddibwamu mu njigiriza ya Evans yonna. Pawulo bw’agamba Abaefeso okujjuzibwa Omwoyo, amangu ago annyonnyola obulamu obwo bwe bufaanana.

Ate temutamiiranga, kubanga mujja kweyonoona, wabula Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe. Bwe mukuŋŋananga muzimbaganenga mu Zabbuli ne mu nnyimba, ne mu nnyimba ez’Omwoyo nga muyimbira Mukama era nga mumuyimusiza amaloboozi mu mutima gwammwe. Bulijjo mwebazenga Katonda Kitaffe olwa byonna, mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Mutyenga Kristo, nga muwuliragananga. ABAEFESO 5:18–21

Omutima ogusinza, omutima ogwebaza n’omutima ogw’omuweereza: buno, Evans bw’agamba, bwe bubonero bw’okujjula. Ekyo akyogera butereevu. Omukkiriza atasinza, eyeemulugunya buli kiseera, oba agaana okwetoowaliza abalala, bw’alowooza, talina kye yeekwasa okwogera nti ajjudde Omwoyo. Era alaga nti ekiragiro kya Pawulo eky’okujjuzibwa kiri mu ngeri egenda mu maaso, n’olwekyo newaakubadde okujjuzibwa okusooka kirabo kya Katonda ky’agaba nga bw’ayagala, okujjuzibwa okugenda mu maaso kye kintu kye tuvunaanyizibwa. Era alaga nti Pawulo essuula ennene ku kwagala agiteeka wakati w’essuula ze ebbiri ku birabo by’Omwoyo. Ebirabo awatali kwagala luyoogaano bwoogaano.

Okujjuzibwa n’okufukibwako amafuta

Evans ayongerako enjawulo endala emu. Okujjuzibwa, bw’agamba, kuli munda; okufukibwako amafuta kuli ku ffe. Okujjuzibwa kututegekera obuweereza; okufukibwako amafuta kujja nga tusumululwa okuyingira mu buweereza Katonda bw’atuyitidde. Okujjuzibwa, mu bbanga, kusinziira ku ngeri gye tweggulamu; okufukibwako amafuta kusigala nga Katonda y’akulonda nga bw’ayagala. Okufukibwako amafuta akunnyonnyola nga Katonda okuteeka envumbo ye ku muntu oba ku buweereza, ne bubaako ekikolwa eky’olubeerera ku abo be bukwatako. Essuula ey’ekkumi n’etaano ekomawo ku kino.

Ebirabo, n’okwawula

Evans akkiriza ebirabo by’Omwoyo, nga mw’otwalidde obunnabbi, ebigambo eby’okumanya n’okuwonya, era, nga Alliance bw’ebadde eyigiriza bulijjo, nti okuwonyezebwa kuli mu birungi ebiva ku musaalaba; ategeeza nti naye yennyini yawonyezebwa. Naye akakasa nti tewali nkola egobererwa, era aziyiza n’amaanyi ge gamu okusukkiriza kw’abo abagoberera ebirabo: obunnabbi obw’omuntu ku bubwe obutalina abubuuliriza, okukozesa abantu okuva ku bituuti, n’enneewulira okutwalibwa ng’okubeerawo kw’Omwoyo. Ky’ayagala si luyoogaano wabula Katonda.

Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange, bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye. ZEKKALIYA 4:6

Okupima enjigiriza

Wano omusomi asaana okumanya nti Evans alonda oludda mu kukubaganya ebirowoozo okumaze ebbanga eddene mu Bakristaayo abeesigwa. Abakkiriza bangi, nga mw’otwalidde bangi abeegomba amaanyi g’Omwoyo nga bw’agegomba, ebitundu bye bimu babisoma mu ngeri ndala. Pentekoote bagitwala ng’akaseera ak’enjawulo akatalibaawo nate mu byafaayo by’obulokozi, ne Abaefeso 1:13 ng’ekiyigiriza nti buli mukkiriza ateekebwako envumbo y’Omwoyo ng’akkirizza. Okujjuzibwa okw’oluvannyuma bakutwala ng’okuddamu okumanya Omwoyo eyaweebwa dda, so si ng’omutendera ogw’okubiri buli Mukristaayo gw’alina okunoonya. Evans kino akimanyi bulungi; abamu ku mikwano gye egy’oku lusegere e Victoria baava mu kibiina kya Brethren ekyali kirina endowooza endala, era yabassaamu ekitiibwa. Ate era ayogera n’obukambwe okusinga bangi bwe bandyogedde ku bayigiriza abakkiriza nti ebirabo by’eby’amagero byakoma.

Buli muntu ky’asobola okumuyigirako kwe kugaana kwe okumatira n’okukkiriza okutaliimu maanyi. Ka kibe nti olowooza otya ku ngeri ebintu gye biddiriŋŋanamu, Ebyawandiikibwa biragira buli mukkiriza okujjuzibwa Omwoyo, era obubonero bw’okujjula okwo, okusinza, okwebaza n’obuweereza obw’obwetoowaze, busobola okugezesebwa mu bulamu bwa buli muntu.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Gezesa obulamu bwo n’obubonero busatu obwa Evans: oli musinza, oli muntu eyeebaza, era oli muweereza? Ebbanga lisinga kuba ddene wa?

2. Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1 ne 2 mpola, nga weetegereza abayigirizwa kye baakola nga balindirira.

3. Saba Kitaffe, mu bwesimbu era nga tolekulira, okujjula kw’Omwoyo we, nga Lukka 11:13 bwe kukuyita.

4. Bw’oba olina endowooza ey’enjawulo ku ya Evans ku kubatizibwa mu Mwoyo, weebuuze obanga endowooza yo ekumatiza n’ekitono okusinga Katonda ky’ayagala.

5. Lowooza ku kitundu kimu eky’obuweereza mw’obadde weesigama ku busobozi bwo. Saba Katonda amaanyi ge mu kyo.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, wassiza omukka ku bayigirizwa bo n’obawa obulamu, oluvannyuma n’obajjuza amaanyi agava mu ggulu. Saagala kubeera na kitono okusinga ky’oyagala.
Njijuza Omwoyo wo. Nfuula omusinza, nfuula eyeebaza mu byonna, era onfuule omuweereza w’abantu bo.
Nkuuma nneme kunoonya luyoogaano mu kifo ky’okubeerawo kwo, n’okukozesa ebirabo byo awatali kwagala kwo.
Nga bwe wafukibwako amafuta okubuulira abaavu Enjiri, nfukako amafuta olw’omulimu gw’ompadde. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Mirimu ki ebiri egy’Omwoyo egyawukana Evans gy’alaba mu Yokaana 20:22 ne ku Pentekoote?
study_questions.answer: Akkiriza nti abayigirizwa bazaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri Yesu bwe yabassiza omukka akawungeezi k’olunaku lw’okuzuukira, n’oluvannyuma ne bajjuzibwa Omwoyo mu maanyi wiiki musanvu oluvannyuma ku Pentekoote, nga baali bagambiddwa okulindirira mu Yerusaalemi. Ogusooka kwe kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri mu mubiri gwa Kristo; ogw’okubiri kwe kubatizibwa mu Mwoyo, Mukama eyazuukira mw’awera abantu be amaanyi okuba abajulirwa.

study_questions.question: Nsonga ki Evans gy’aggya mu bulamu bwa Yesu eraga nti twetaaga okufukibwako amafuta g’Omwoyo?
study_questions.answer: Yesu yafunyisibwa olubuto lwa Mwoyo era yali ajjudde Omwoyo okuva lwe yazaalibwa, naye teyatandika buweereza bwe obw’olwatu okutuusa Omwoyo lwe yamukkako ku kubatizibwa kwe, n’oluvannyuma n’alangirira e Nazaaleesi nti ebigambo bya Isaaya bituukiridde. Obanga Yesu yeetaaga okufukibwako amafuta g’Omwoyo okukola omulimu gwe, Evans abuuza, ffe tetusinga nnyo okugeetaaga?

study_questions.question: Bubonero ki busatu obw’okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Evans bw’aggya mu Abaefeso 5?
study_questions.answer: Omutima ogusinza, omutima ogwebaza n’omutima ogw’omuweereza, ebiva mu bigambo bya Pawulo ku Zabbuli n’ennyimba ez’Omwoyo, ku kwebaza bulijjo, ne ku kuwuliragana. Ayogera butereevu nti omukkiriza atasinza, eyeemulugunya buli kiseera oba agaana okwetoowaliza abalala talina kye yeekwasa okwogera nti ajjudde Omwoyo.

study_questions.question: Evans ayawula atya okujjuzibwa n’okufukibwako amafuta?
study_questions.answer: Okujjuzibwa kuli munda era kututegekera obuweereza, era mu bbanga kusinziira ku ngeri gye tweggulamu; okufukibwako amafuta kuli ku ffe, kujja nga tusumululwa okuyingira mu buweereza Katonda bw’atuyitidde, era kusigala nga Katonda y’akulonda nga bw’ayagala. Okufukibwako amafuta akunnyonnyola nga Katonda okuteeka envumbo ye ku muntu oba ku buweereza, ne bubaako ekikolwa eky’olubeerera ku abo be bukwatako.

study_questions.question: Essuula ennyonnyola etya endowooza y’abo abasoma ebitundu bino mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku ya Evans?
study_questions.answer: Abakkiriza bangi abeesigwa Pentekoote bagitwala ng’akaseera ak’enjawulo mu byafaayo by’obulokozi, ne Abaefeso 1:13 ng’ekiyigiriza nti buli mukkiriza ateekebwako envumbo y’Omwoyo ng’akkirizza, n’olwekyo okujjuzibwa okw’oluvannyuma kuba kuddamu kumanya Omwoyo eyaweebwa dda so si mutendera gwa kubiri. Ka kibe ndowooza ki, essuula egamba, Ebyawandiikibwa biragira buli mukkiriza okujjuzibwa, era obubonero bw’okujjula busobola okugezesebwa mu bulamu bwa buli muntu.

fields.title: Abantu ab’Endagaano
fields.body_html:
Era mu ngeri y’emu bwe baamala okulya, yaddira ekikompe n’agamba nti, “Ekikompe kino y’endagaano empya ekoleddwa Katonda nammwe, ekakasiddwa n’omusaayi gwange, mutoole munywe, mukolenga bwe mutyo buli lwe munaakinywangako okunzijukiranga.” 1 ABAKKOLINSO 11:25

Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange, ekitabo kya Evans ekisooka, tekitandika na biwundu wadde okusonyiwa, wabula kitandikira mu kisenge ekya waggulu. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’essuula yonna mu Okuliira ku Mmeeza. Ensonga ye nnyangu. Singa wali omanyi nti osigazza olunaku lumu lwokka okubeera omulamu, bw’abuuza, wandikoze ki? Tewandirumazizza ku bintu ebitaliimu. Wandikuŋŋaanyizza abo b’oyagala, n’obabuulira ekisinga obukulu, n’otereeza buli kintu ekyonoonese wakati wammwe. Mu kiro ekyasembayo nga tannafa, Yesu ekyo kyennyini kye yakola. Yakola ku bintu ebisinga obukulu.

Ebisaanyizo bisatu

Evans asanga ebisaanyizo bisatu mu bigambo Yesu bye yagamba abayigirizwa be mu Yokaana 13 ne 14.

Ekisooka bwe buweereza. Abayigirizwa baatuuka n’ebigere ebijjudde enfuufu nga tewali muddu wa kubinaaza, era Yesu yennyini n’addira ekiremba n’ebbensani n’anaaza ebigere byabwe, nga mw’otwalidde n’ebigere bya Yuda, eyali agenda okumulyamu olukwe mu kiro ekyo.

Kale Nze Mukama wammwe era Omuyigiriza, nga bwe mbanaazizza ebigere, nammwe musaana okunaazagananga ebigere. YOKAANA 13:14

Evans talowooza nti Yesu yali ategeeza okusinga byonna omukolo, newaakubadde ng’emikolo gy’okunaaza ebigere gimuleetedde omukisa. Yali ategeeza nti tulina okuzzaamu bannaffe amaanyi nga tubaggyako obucaafu obubeekwatako olw’okutambula mu nsi eno. Ekyo, bw’agamba, kye kimu ku bigendererwa ebikulu eby’okussa ekimu kw’Abakristaayo, era y’emu ku nsonga lwaki agenda mu kkanisa: okunaazibwa ebigere bye. Ekibi ennyo kiri nti emirundi mingi obucaafu obukasukibwa mu bakkiriza bwenkana obwo obukasukibwa mu batakkiriza.

Eky’okubiri kwe kwagala. Yesu yawa ekiragiro ekiggya, so si kya kweroboza: twagalanenga nga ye bw’atwagala. Okusiimagana, Evans bw’ayogera ng’asaaga, tekiragirwa; okwagalana kwe kulagirwa, era okwagala kugaana olugambo n’okwogera obubi ku balala emabega waabwe, ne kututegeka okussa ekitiibwa mu balala n’okubakulembeza.

Mbawa ekiragiro ekiggya: Mwagalanenga nga nze bwe mbaagala. YOKAANA 13:34

Eky’okusatu bwe buwulize eri ekigambo kye. Kale obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange.

Ebisuubizo n’endagaano

Ku mabbali g’ebisaanyizo, Yesu yawa n’ebisuubizo: ekifo ekitegekeddwa mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe, okudda kwe, Omubeezi, emirembe ensi gy’etasobola kuwa wadde okuggyawo, n’essanyu erijjuvu. Evans alaga nti ebisuubizo bino bisuubizo bya ndagaano. Okubinyumirwa kwesigamye ku bayigirizwa okutuukiriza oludda lwabwe: okuba abaweereza, abaagala, era abawulize.

Eyo y’ensonga lwaki akiyita endagaano ey’ekisenge ekya waggulu. Endagaano, bw’annyonnyola, kwe kukkiriziganya wakati w’enjuyi bbiri, era mu nsi ey’edda endagaano zaakolebwanga nga wayiibwa omusaayi. Yesu bwe yaddira ekikompe n’akiyita endagaano empya mu musaayi gwe, abayigirizwa, bw’alaga, tebaabuuza kye yali ategeeza. Baategeera. N’olwekyo, Evans bw’agamba, buli lwe tulya omugaati ne tunywa ku kikompe, tuddamu okukakasa endagaano yaffe. Bwe tulya omugaati tulangirira nti tuli kitundu ku mubiri gwa Kristo. Bwe tunywa ku kikompe tuddamu okweyama okuweerezagana, okwagalana n’okugondera ekigambo kye. Annyonnyola empisa ye ku Mmeeza ya Mukama ey’okwetooloola amaaso ku kibiina ng’alya omugaati, n’okuddamu mu kasirise okweyama ebintu ebyo ebisatu ng’anywa ku kikompe.

Noolwekyo omuntu amalenga kwekebera, alyoke alye ku mugaati n’okunywa ku kikompe. 1 ABAKKOLINSO 11:28

Obumu obubuulira Enjiri

Okuva mu kisenge ekya waggulu Evans agenda ku ssaala ya Yesu mu Yokaana 17, ne ku ky’atwala ng’engeri y’okubuulira Enjiri ekkanisa gy’esinga okulagajjalira. Tosobola, bw’alaga, kuyuzaamu lupapula lumu lwa Bayibuli n’oluwa omuntu ng’akapapula k’Enjiri. Naye osobola okulaga essuula zonna ezitubuulira engeri Katonda gy’ayagala ensi ekkirizeemu.

Bonna babeere bumu, nga ggwe Kitange bw’oli mu Nze, nange nga ndi mu ggwe, nabo babeerenga mu ffe, ensi eryoke ekkirize nga ggwe wantuma. YOKAANA 17:21

Abantu ba Katonda bwe babeera awamu ng’abaweereza era ng’abaagalana mu buwulize, bw’agamba, ensi ejja kumanya era ekkirize. Obulamu bw’ekkanisa yennyini obw’okubeera awamu bwe bubaka Katonda bw’ayagala ensi esome. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki yeegayirira ekkanisa okwolekera enjawukana zaayo n’obukyayi bwayo, ensi bye bulaba obulungi ennyo, mu bwangu nga bw’eyolekera enjigiriza ez’obulimba.

Omubiri gumu

Evans awa ekifo kinene ekifaananyi kya Pawulo eky’ekkanisa ng’omubiri: si kibiina abantu kye baakola wabula ekiramu Katonda kye yatonda, buli mukkiriza, ka abe ow’ekkanisa ki, mwe yabatirizibwa Omwoyo omu. Tawakanya biwayi by’ekkanisa nga bwe biri. Naye ebibinja byaffe bwe bitwawula ku abo abali mu Kristo abaawukana naffe ku ngeri y’okusinza oba ku makulu ag’okubiri, twereetako omusango.

Eriiso terisobola kugamba mukono nti, “Ggwe sikwetaaga,” oba n’omutwe teguyinza kugamba bigere nti, “Mmwe sibeetaaga.” 1 ABAKKOLINSO 12:21

Amazima ag’ennaku

Tasaasira nnyo bw’ayogera ku ngeri ekkanisa gy’ekyalemererwamu. Obufumbo bw’Abakristaayo obwandiraze ensi okwagala kwa Kristo eri omugole we bukoma mu kwawukana emirundi mingi nga obw’abalala. Abaana abakulira mu maka g’Abakristaayo basitula ebiwundu bya bakitaabwe abaabanyiiza. Abasuubuzi bamugamba nti Abakristaayo bayinza okuba mu basinga okukaluubiriza mu by’enfuna. Abaminsani, bw’alaga, bava mu nnimiro emirundi mingi olw’enkolagana ezaayonooneka okusinga olw’obulwadde oba ensimbi, n’abasumba bava mu kkanisa oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mitono egy’ebisuubirwa ebitaatuukirira. Amakanisa gavuganya ku bagoberezi ba bannaago, era oluusi geeyuzaayuza mu nnyombo ekibuga kyonna ze kijjukira. Oluvannyuma lwa buli kyokulabirako abuuza, mu ngeri emu, ensi etunuulidde kye yandikitegeddemu.

Takibuuza ng’asalira musango. Akibuuza kubanga akkiriza nti omulabe w’emmeeme zaffe okwonoona enkolagana akufudde enkola ye esinga obukulu, olw’ensonga eyo nti obumu Katonda abutwala nga kye kisinga obukulu. Essuula ebbiri eziddako zoogera ku ddagala lye.

Okwegendereza ku bulwadde

Ekitundu kimu eky’enjigiriza ya Evans ku ndagaano kyetaaga okwegendereza. Okuva ku kulabula kwa Pawulo nti Abakkolinso abamu baali banafu era abalwadde kubanga baalyanga ku Ky’Ekiro kya Mukama mu ngeri etasaana, n’okuva ku kiragiro kya Yakobo eky’okuyita abakadde, alowooza nti obulwadde obumu mu bakkiriza buyinza okuba nga bukwatagana n’enkolagana ezaayonooneka mu mubiri, era nti abakadde basaana okwawula obanga okutabagana kwetaagisa nga tebannasaba. Mutuufu nti Ebyawandiikibwa bikwataganya ebyo mu mbeera ezimu, era okufaayo kwe ng’omusumba kwa mazima. Naye Ebyawandiikibwa ebyo bye bimu biraga nti obulwadde obusinga obungi tebuva ku nsonga eyo, nga Yesu bwe yayogera ku musajja eyazaalibwa nga muzibe w’amaaso, era Evans yennyini awakanya nnyo abo abagamba abalwadde nti obulwadde bwabwe bukakasa nti waliwo kye baalemererwa. Enjigiriza ye esinga kukkirizibwa ng’okuyitibwa okwekebera ku Mmeeza, so si ng’okuzuula obulwadde okw’okukozesa ku balala.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Omulundi oguddako bw’onoolya ku Ky’Ekiro kya Mukama, ddamu okweyama mu bugenderevu ebintu ebisatu eby’ekisenge ekya waggulu: okuweereza, okwagala n’okugondera.

2. Lowooza ku muntu mu kkanisa yo eyeetaaga okunaazibwa ebigere wiiki eno, omuntu akooye oba aweddemu amaanyi. Kola ekintu ekirabika okumuzzaamu amaanyi.

3. Waliwo muganda wo oba mwannyoko gw’otosiima? Saba Katonda ekisa okumwagala, era okwagala okwo kulage mu kikolwa kimu ekirabika.

4. Lowooza obanga ekkanisa yo enkola ey’obukyamu egitwala nga ya maanyi nga enjigiriza ey’obukyamu. Saba olw’obumu bw’amakanisa ag’omu kibuga kyo ng’ogoogerako amannya gaago.

5. Bw’oba ositudde obukyayi eri omuntu mu mubiri, tonywa ku kikompe okutuusa ng’otandiseeko okunoonya okutabagana.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, mu kiro kye walyamu olukwe waddira ekiremba n’onaaza ebigere bya mikwano gyo, n’eby’oyo eyali agenda okukulyamu olukwe. Nfuula omuweereza nga ggwe.
Wandagira okwagala nga ggwe bw’onjagala. Sisobola kukikola awatali kisa kyo; kimpe olw’abantu be nsinga okulemererwa okwagala.
Bwe ndya omugaati ne nnywa ku kikompe, nkitegeeze ddala kye neeyama: okuweereza abantu bo, okwagala abantu bo n’okugondera ekigambo kyo.
Tufuule bumu, Mukama, ensi eryoke ekkirize nti Kitaffe ye yakutuma. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans enjigiriza ye ku nkolagana agitandikira mu kisenge ekya waggulu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga singa wali omanyi nti osigazza olunaku lumu lwokka okubeera omulamu, wandikuŋŋaanyizza abo b’oyagala, n’obabuulira ekisinga obukulu, n’otereeza buli kintu ekyonoonese wakati wammwe. Mu kiro ekyasembayo nga tannafa, Yesu ekyo kyennyini kye yakola: yakola ku bintu ebisinga obukulu.

study_questions.question: Bisaanyizo ki bisatu Evans by’asanga mu bigambo bya Yesu mu Yokaana 13 ne 14?
study_questions.answer: Obuweereza, obwalabikira Yesu bwe yanaaza ebigere by’abayigirizwa be, nga mw’otwalidde ebya Yuda; okwagala, ekiragiro ekiggya so si kya kweroboza, ekigaana olugambo n’okwogera obubi ku balala emabega waabwe; n’obuwulize eri ekigambo kye. Evans ayogera ng’asaaga nti okusiimagana tekiragirwa, naye okwagalana kulagirwa.

study_questions.question: Evans akkiriza nti Yesu yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba abayigirizwa okunaazagananga ebigere?
study_questions.answer: Si mukolo okusinga byonna, wabula nti abakkiriza basaana okuzzaamu bannaabwe amaanyi nga babaggyako obucaafu obubeekwatako olw’okutambula mu nsi eno. Ekyo, bw’agamba, kye kimu ku bigendererwa ebikulu eby’okussa ekimu kw’Abakristaayo era y’emu ku nsonga lwaki agenda mu kkanisa, newaakubadde nga emirundi mingi obucaafu obukasukibwa mu bakkiriza bwenkana obwo obukasukibwa mu batakkiriza.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans enjigiriza eno agiyita endagaano ey’ekisenge ekya waggulu, era ekyo kikyusa kitya engeri gy’atunuuliramu Eky’Ekiro kya Mukama?
study_questions.answer: Ebisuubizo bya Yesu eby’ekifo ekitegekeddwa, okudda kwe, Omubeezi, emirembe n’essanyu bisuubizo bya ndagaano, era okubinyumirwa kwesigamye ku bayigirizwa okuba abaweereza, abaagala era abawulize, era ekikompe yakiyita endagaano empya mu musaayi gwe. N’olwekyo buli lwe tulya ku Ky’Ekiro kya Mukama tuddamu okukakasa endagaano: mu mugaati tulangirira nti tuli kitundu ku mubiri gwa Kristo, ne mu kikompe tuddamu okweyama okuweereza, okwagala n’okugondera.

study_questions.question: Evans ayita ki engeri y’okubuulira Enjiri ekkanisa gy’esinga okulagajjalira?
study_questions.answer: Obumu bw’abakkiriza, obuva mu ssaala ya Yesu mu Yokaana 17 nti bonna babeere bumu ensi eryoke ekkirize. Abantu ba Katonda bwe babeera awamu ng’abaweereza era ng’abaagalana mu buwulize, obulamu bw’ekkanisa yennyini obw’okubeera awamu bufuuka obubaka Katonda bw’ayagala ensi esome.

fields.title: Olwazi Olwesittalwako
fields.body_html:
Ebikemo ebireetera abantu okwonoona tebiyinza butajja, naye zimusanze omuntu oyo abireeta. LUKKA 17:1

Obanga obumu Katonda abutwala nga kye kisinga obukulu, Evans bw’alowooza, bulina okuba nga bwe buyiga omulabe bw’ayigga. Mu Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange annyonnyola enkwe Setaani z’akozesa ku bakkiriza: okuwuluguma kw’empologoma okukozesa enneewulira zaffe, obusaale obw’omuliro obw’obulimba obulasibwa mu birowoozo byaffe, n’eddobo ly’omuvubi erisuulibwa mu biwundu eby’edda. Naye olukwe lw’asinga okuwandiikako, era lw’asinga okubuuliramu, kwe kwesittazibwa. Akkiriza nti kye kisinga ebirala byonna okuleeta enjawukana mu kkanisa, abaminsani okuva mu nnimiro, n’abasumba okuleka obuweereza.

Okwesittazibwa si kibi

Evans atandika n’enjawulo eyeewuunyisa abasomi bangi. Okwesittazibwa n’ekibi si kye kimu. Yesu yennyini yali lwazi olwesittalwako, nga Pawulo ne Peetero bombi bwe bagamba, era teyalina kibi.

Era “Lye jjinja abantu lye beekoonako, lwe lwazi kwe beesittala ne bagwa.” Beesittala kubanga bajeemera ekigambo kya Katonda, nga bwe ky’ateekebwateekebwa. 1 PEETERO 2:8

Abafalisaayo baamwesittalako, abantu b’ewaabwe baamwesittalako, era n’ab’omu maka ge baamunyiigira. Oluusi, Evans bw’alowooza, Yesu alabika ng’eyaleetanga okwesittala mu bugenderevu. Ebiseera ebirala, nga ku musolo gwa yeekaalu, yeegendereza obutabanyiiza. Okwesittazibwa ku bwakyo si kibi. Kye tukola n’okwesittazibwa okwo kintu kirala.

Kino akisanga mu lugero lwa Kayini. Katonda teyagaana kiweebwayo kya Kayini kubanga Kayini yali ayonoonye; tewali kigambo mu kyawandiikibwa kiraga nti ekirabo kye kyali kibi. Naye Kayini n’asunguwala, n’endabika y’amaaso ge n’ewaanyisibwa, era Katonda n’amulabula nti ekibi kyali kimuteeze ku mulyango. Okwesittazibwa kwe kwasooka; ekibi kyaddirira bwe yagaana okukiwangula.

Bw’onookolanga obulungi tokkirizibwenga? Naye bw’otokole bulungi ekibi, kiri kumpi naawe, nga kikulindiridde, naye oteekwa okukiwangula. OLUBEREBERYE 4:7

Okwesittazibwa kye kufiiriza

Mu Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange ne mu Ennaku Zange Ez’Omu Maaso Ziri mu Mikono Gye, Evans alaga ebyokulabirako bitaano okuva mu Njiri eby’abantu abeesittala, n’ekyo kye kyabafiiriza. Awulira ekigambo ali ku ttaka ery’enjazi akkiriza ekigambo n’essanyu naye yeesittala ebizibu bwe bijja, era tabala bibala. Abantu b’e Nazaaleesi beesittala ku mwana w’omubazzi, era ye takolerayo byamagero bingi. Yuda yeesittala olw’okwonoonebwa kw’amafuta ag’omuwendo omungi, n’afuluma okulyamu Mukama we olukwe, ng’amaze okumuggyamu obwesige bwonna. Peetero yeesittala mu kiro Yesu kye yakwatibwamu, n’amwegaana mu maaso g’omuwala omuweereza, n’afiirwa obujulirwa bwe. Era abayigirizwa bangi, abeesittala olw’ebigambo bya Yesu ebizibu ku kulya omubiri gwe, baddayo ne bataddamu kutambula naye.

Okuva olwo bangi ku bayigirizwa be ne bamuvaako ne bataddayo kuyita naye. YOKAANA 6:66

Tewali bibala, tewali byamagero, tewali bwesige, tewali bujulirwa, tewali kussa kimu: ebyo, eri Evans, bye bikungulwa okuva mu kwesittazibwa okulabirirwa so si okukolebwako.

Okwesittala ku Yesu

Ebyokulabirako bye bibiri bya mutima nnyo. Yokaana Omubatiza, ng’ali mu kkomera, yalindirira ow’oluganda lwe gwe yali alangiridde ng’Omwana gw’Endiga owa Katonda okujja amusumulule. Yesu teyajja. Yokaana n’atuma okubuuza obanga ddala ye Oyo Ajja, era Yesu n’amuddamu n’olukalala lw’emirimu gye n’okulabula okw’obukkakkamu.

Alina omukisa oyo atanneesittalako. MATAYO 11:6

Eky’okubiri ye Maliyamu ow’e Besaniya. Laazaalo bwe yafa, Maliza n’afuluma okusisinkana Yesu, naye Maliyamu n’asigala mu nnyumba. Bwe yasembayo okujja, yayogera ebigambo bye bimu nga muganda we, naye Yesu n’amuddamu mu ngeri ya njawulo; n’akaaba amaziga. Evans alowooza nti Maliyamu yali yeesittadde kubanga Yesu teyajja mu budde, era nti Yesu yakaaba, si lwa Laazaalo, gwe yali anaatera okuzuukiza, wabula kubanga mukwano gwe yali amwesittaliddeko.

Kuno kusoma okusikiriza omutima, era kuyambye bangi okulaba mu ngeri empya obulumi bwabwe olw’ekiseera Katonda ky’akoleramu. Naye kisaana okwogerwa mu lwatu nti kusukka ekyo ekyawandiikibwa kye kigamba. Yokaana atubuulira nti Yesu yakaaba bwe yalaba Maliyamu n’abakungubazi nga bakaaba, era abasomi bangi amaziga ge bagategeera ng’okusaasira n’ennaku olw’okuzikiriza okw’okufa. Okutegeera kwa Evans kusinga kukwatibwa ng’engeri emu ey’okukozesaamu ekyawandiikibwa so si ng’amakulu g’ekitundu ekyo.

Lwaki Katonda akikkiriza

Lwaki Katonda akkiriza ebyesittaza okujja? Evans addamu nti bitulaga ekintu ekitukwatako. Yokaana Omubatiza yali agambye nti Kristo alina okweyongera ye n’akendeera, naye yali akyetaaga okuyiga nti entegeka y’ebiseera yali ya Katonda so si yiye. Abakkiriza bakemebwa mangu okugezaako okuluŋŋamya Katonda akole ebintu mu ngeri yaabwe, n’okwesittala bw’agaana. Ebyesittaza y’emu ku ngeri Katonda gy’atugezesaamu n’atulongoosa, ng’ayanika amalala, ebisuubirwa eby’obulimba n’okwagala okweyoleka.

Abala ensibuko ezitera okubaawo: embala ezitakwatagana, ebisuubirwa ebitayogerwa era ebitatuukirira, obutategeeragana, obuggya olw’ebirabo by’abalala, amalala agalumiziddwa n’obujeemu obwangu.

Ky’olina okukola nakwo

Okubuulirira kwa Evans, mu Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange, kwangu era kwa kukolerako, era akuteeka mu mitendera. Ekisooka, kkiriza nti okwesittazibwa okwo kwo: kwo ggwe, kubanga omuntu omulala ayinza okuba nga teyayonoona n’akatono; ggwe wakulonda n’okukwata. Ekiddako, kuyigireko: buuza Katonda ky’akulaga ku ggwe kennyini. Olwo kuleke: salawo okukussa wansi, kusabire, sabira omukisa oyo eyakwesittaza, era saba Omwoyo ekisa bw’owulira nga kuzitowa nnyo. Ekisembayo, kuleke emabega: tokukkiriza kusenga mu mutima gwo. Era ku nkomerero, weegendereze oleme kuba nsibuko ya kwesittazibwa eri abalala.

Buli muntu afe ku munne waleme kubeerawo n’omu ava mu kisa kya Katonda, era mwekuume ensigo ey’obukyayi ereme okuloka mu mmwe, bangi ne bagwagwawala. ABAEBBULANIYA 12:15

Ayongerako ensonga okuva mu Matayo 18 bangi gye basanga ng’ebasumulula. Yesu atugamba okugenda eri muganda waffe atusobezza. Tatugamba kugenda eri buli muntu atwesittazizza. Obukuubagano bungi bwandiweweddwa singa abakkiriza baakussa bussa wansi okwesittazibwa kwabwe mu kifo ky’okwolekera abalala ku nsonga ezo, era n’obulala bungi singa abo abaagala okuva mu kkanisa baakikola mu kisa, nga babuulira omusumba waabwe mu kifo ky’okuseeyeeya obuseeyeezi ne bagenda.

“Bwe musunguwalanga mwekuume muleme kwonoona.” Temuzibyanga budde nga mukyasunguwadde. Temuwanga Setaani bbanga. ABAEFESO 4:26–27

Obusungu n’obulumi nneewulira, era enneewulira ku bwazo si kibi. Naye bwe zitakolebwako, ziwa Setaani we ayimiriza ekigere. Okubuulirira kwa Evans kwe kuzikolako ku lunaku olwo lwennyini.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Saba Mukama akulage okwesittazibwa kwonna kw’ositudde, ku muntu, ku kkanisa oba ne ku ye. Kiwandiike.

2. Okwesittazibwa okwo kuyise mu mitendera gya Evans: kkiriza nti kwo, kuyigireko, kuleke era okuleke emabega. Tobuuka mutendera gwa kuyiga.

3. Waliwo ekifo w’owulidde nga weesittadde olw’ekiseera Katonda ky’akoleramu? Kimuleetere mu mazima, nga Maliyamu bwe yakomekkereza ng’ajja eri Yesu.

4. Mu bukuubagano bumu obuliwo kaakano, yawula wakati w’okwesittazibwa n’okusobezebwa. Bw’oba wasobezebwa, lowooza ku kugenda mu kyama, nga Matayo 18:15 bwe kulagira.

5. Weebuuze obanga waliwo gw’oleetera okwesittala. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, genda okitereeze.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, wali lwazi olwesittalwako eri bangi, era nange nneesittadde bw’otaakola nga bwe nnali nsuubira. Nsonyiwa.
Ndaga okwesittazibwa kwe nnakwata ne nkusitula. Mpa ekisa okukikkiriza nti kwange, okukuyigirako, okukussa wansi n’okukuleka gy’oli.
Kuuma omutima gwange obukyayi, era tondeka kuzibya budde nga nkyasunguwadde.
Alina omukisa oyo atakwesittalako. Nfuula omuntu ali bw’atyo. Amiina.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Evans akakasa nti okwesittazibwa si kye kimu n’okwonoona?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga Yesu yennyini yali lwazi olwesittalwako era teyalina kibi, era Abafalisaayo, abantu b’ewaabwe n’ab’omu maka ge baamwesittalako. Okwesittazibwa ku bwakyo si kibi; kye tukola nakwo kintu kirala, nga ku Kayini, okwesittazibwa kwe kwasooka era ekibi kyaddirira bwe yagaana okukiwangula.

study_questions.question: Okwesittazibwa kwafiiriza ki ebyokulabirako ebitaano eby’omu Njiri Evans by’alaga?
study_questions.answer: Awulira ali ku ttaka ery’enjazi teyabala bibala, Nazaaleesi yalabayo ebyamagero bitono, Yuda yaggya obwesige bwonna mu Mukama we, Peetero yafiirwa obujulirwa bwe bwe yeegaana Kristo, n’abayigirizwa abeesittala olw’ebigambo bya Yesu ebizibu tebaddamu kutambula naye. Tewali bibala, tewali byamagero, tewali bwesige, tewali bujulirwa, tewali kussa kimu: ebyo bye bikungulwa okuva mu kwesittazibwa okulabirirwa so si okukolebwako.

study_questions.question: Evans asoma atya ennaku ya Maliyamu ow’e Besaniya ku kufa kwa Laazaalo, era essuula epima etya okusoma okwo?
study_questions.answer: Alowooza nti Maliyamu yali yeesittadde kubanga Yesu teyajja mu budde, era nti Yesu yakaaba si lwa Laazaalo wabula kubanga mukwano gwe yali amwesittaliddeko. Essuula ekuyita okusoma okusikiriza omutima naye egamba nti kusukka ekyo ekyawandiikibwa kye kigamba, kubanga bangi amaziga ge bagategeera ng’okusaasira n’ennaku olw’okufa, n’olwekyo kusinga kukwatibwa ng’engeri emu ey’okukozesaamu ekyawandiikibwa.

study_questions.question: Okusinziira ku Evans, lwaki Katonda akkiriza ebyesittaza okujja?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga bitulaga ekintu ekitukwatako, nga Yokaana Omubatiza bwe yali akyetaaga okuyiga nti entegeka y’ebiseera yali ya Katonda so si yiye. Ebyesittaza y’emu ku ngeri Katonda gy’atugezesaamu n’atulongoosa, ng’ayanika amalala, ebisuubirwa eby’obulimba n’okwagala okweyoleka, bwe tukemebwa okugezaako okumuluŋŋamya akole ebintu mu ngeri yaffe.

study_questions.question: Nsonga ki esumulula Evans gy’aggya mu Matayo 18 ku kugenda eri abalala?
study_questions.answer: Yesu atugamba okugenda eri muganda waffe atusobezza, so si eri buli muntu atwesittazizza. Obukuubagano bungi bwandiweweddwa singa abakkiriza baakussa bussa wansi okwesittazibwa kwabwe mu kifo ky’okwolekera abalala ku nsonga ezo.

fields.title: Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange
fields.body_html:
Mubenga ba kisa, buli omu alumirwenga munne, era musonyiwaganenga, nga Katonda bwe yabasonyiwa mu Kristo. ABAEFESO 4:32

Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange kye kitabo kya Evans ekisinga okumanyika, era enjigiriza erimu etambudde wala okusinga ekirala kyonna ky’awandiise. Yagiyigiriza ebibinja by’abavubuka n’abantu abawummudde, ebibiina ebisinza mu nkola ey’emikolo egyategekebwa n’amakanisa ag’eddembe, amatendekero ga Bayibuli n’enkuŋŋaana z’abasajja ez’okwewummuzaamu, era agamba nti kumpi buli wamu yakwatanga ku nneewulira z’abantu. Omulamwa gwayo kwe kuwonyezebwa kw’emmeeme ezaafumitibwa n’enkolagana ezaamenyeka, era ekisumuluzo kyayo, ng’omutwe bwe gugamba, kwe kusonyiwa.

Ekitonde ekiggya, n’emmeeme eyafumitibwa

Evans atandika n’ekibuuzo ekyamutawaanya ng’akyali Mukristaayo omuto. Obanga omuntu yenna ali mu Kristo kitonde kiggya, lwaki abakkiriza bangi bwe batyo bakyalwanagana n’okutya, n’ebibasikiriza okukola ebintu nga tebasobola kubyewala, n’obulumi bye baali basitula nga tebannakyuka? Yali aleeteddwa okuwulira omusango olw’okuba nti eby’edda tebyali birabika nga biweddewo.

Eky’okuddamu kye kikozesa entegeka ennyangu ey’omwoyo, emmeeme n’omubiri. Ku kukyuka, bw’agamba, omwoyo gw’omuntu, ogwali gufudde eri Katonda, guzuukizibwa; ekyo kye kitonde ekiggya. Omubiri mu lwatu tegufuulibwa muggya; gugenda gukaddiwa era gulinunulibwa ku kuzuukira kwokka. N’emmeeme, kw’ategeeza ebirowoozo, okusalawo n’enneewulira, nayo tewonyezebwa mangu ago. Esitula mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo ebiwundu by’edda, era ebiwundu ebyo bifuuka olutalo omulabe w’ayagala okukolera.

Katonda ow’emirembe abatukulize ddala, era omwoyo gwammwe gwonna, n’emmeeme yammwe n’omubiri gwammwe, bikuumibwenga nga tebiriiko kya kunenyezebwa okutuusa ku lunaku olw’okujja kwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. 1 BASESSALONIIKA 5:23

Wano alabawo ebiseera bisatu eby’obulokozi. Okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwatulokola okuva ku kibonerezo ky’ekibi; okutukuzibwa kutulokola okuva mu buyinza bwakyo; okugulumizibwa kulitulokola okuva mu kubeerawo kwakyo. Okuwonyezebwa kw’emmeeme, bw’alowooza, kitundu kinene ku mulimu ogwo ogw’okutukuzibwa ogukolebwa kaakano.

Ebiwundu ng’ebyo abyogerako mu bigambo by’okulumizibwa kw’omubiri, okuva ku bisago eby’emyaka mingi egy’okunenyezebwa okutuuka ku biwundu ebiwanvu eby’okutulugunyizibwa ebyaziikibwa, n’okumenyeka kw’amagumba okw’ebintu eby’entiisa abamu bye bawenyerera nabyo okuva olwo. Wano era abuulira emboozi ye yennyini, engeri obulwadde obwamala ebbanga eddene mu 1990 gye bwamutuusa ku kuzuula ekiwundu eky’okulekebwa ekyava ku kufa kwa nnyina, kye yali tannakungubagira.

Azzaamu amaanyi abo abalina emitima egimenyese, era ajjanjaba ebiwundu byabwe. ZABBULI 147:3

Ekisumuluzo

Ddagala ki? Evans assa ekitiibwa mu kubuulirira okulungi era akozesezza ebitabo bingi eby’Ekikristaayo ku kuwonyezebwa kw’omunda. Naye kimweraliikiriza nti bingi ku byo bigenderera kuyamba bantu abaafumitibwa okugumira obugumizi, era nti bitono nnyo ku byo ebyogera ku maanyi g’okusonyiwa agasumulula. Mukama, bw’akkiriza, tagenderera kutuyamba bubeezi kwekuuma n’ebiwundu byaffe wabula okubiwonya, era ekisumuluzo kiri mu mikono gyaffe ffe.

Ekisumuluzo ekyo akisanga mu bigambo bya Yesu ku kusiba n’okusumulula. Amakulu mangi gaweereddwa ku Matayo 16:19, naye Evans alaga nti Yesu addamu ebigambo ebyo eri abayigirizwa bonna mu Matayo 18, mu ssuula eyogera yonna ku kuzzibwa obuggya, okutabagana n’okusonyiwa.

Ddala ddala mbagamba nti byonna bye mulisiba ku nsi, ne mu ggulu birisibwa ne bye mulisumulula ku nsi, ne mu ggulu bigenda kusumululwa. MATAYO 18:18

Kino akigatta n’ebigambo Yesu bye yagamba abayigirizwa akawungeezi k’olunaku lw’okuzuukira:

Buli muntu gwe munaasonyiwanga ebibi bye anaabanga asonyiyiddwa. Abo be munaagaananga okusonyiwa, banaabanga tebasonyiyiddwa. YOKAANA 20:23

Tetusobola kusonyiwa bibi nga Katonda bw’abisonyiwa, Evans bw’agamba; Katonda yekka y’asobola okuggyawo ekibi n’akitwala wala ng’ebuvanjuba bw’eri ewala okuva ebugwanjuba. Naye tusobola okusonyiwa ebibi ebyatukolwako, era mu kukola ekyo tusobola okusumulula abo abaatufumita okuva mu ebyo bye twandibabanje. Bulijjo okusonyiwa n’okusumulula abyogerako wamu. Ekyokulabirako kye ekikulu ye Suteefano, eyasaba ng’akasuulibwako amayinja Mukama aleme kuvunaana batemu be olw’ekibi ekyo.

N’agwa wansi ku maviivi n’akaaba mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Mukama wange, tobavunaana olw’ekibi kino.” Bwe yamala okwogera ekyo, n’afa. EBIKOLWA BY’ABATUME 7:60

Evans yeebuuza mu lwatu obanga Sawulo ow’e Taluso, eyali ayimiridde awo ku lunaku olwo, yandifuuse omutume Pawulo singa Suteefano teyasaba nga bwe yasaba. Okusonyiwa, bw’akkiriza, kuggulawo oluggi Katonda mw’ayinza okuyita okutuuka ku oyo eyatukola obubi. Era kusumulula oyo asonyiwa, abadde asibiddwa ku oyo eyamusobya n’obulumi bw’ekiwundu ng’asibiddwa n’omuguwa.

Okutambulira mu kuwonyezebwa

Okubuulirira kwa Evans okw’okukolerako kwa bukkakkamu era tekwanguyiriza. Agamba abasomi okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu aluŋŋamye ebirowoozo byabwe, n’okuwa ekiseera; okuwonyezebwa kutera obutajja mangu. Abakubiriza okwogera ku by’emabega waabwe, okutegeera mu mazima we baafumitibwa olw’ekibi ky’omulala, nga tebanenya balala olw’ensobi zaabwe bo era nga tebeekwasa nsonga ku lw’abo abaabalumya. Alowooza ku kuwandiika ebbaluwa, etagenda kuweerezebwa n’akatono, ng’olaga mu bulambulukufu engeri gye walumizibwamu ne kye weegombanga, obulumi obwaziikibwa busobole okuleetebwa mu musana. Olwo ne wajja okusalawo okusonyiwa buli kintu ekiwandiikiddwa, n’okusaba essaala ey’okusumulula ng’eya Suteefano; olwo okwonoona ebbaluwa ng’akabonero nti ensonga ewedde; olwo okusabira buli lunaku omukisa ku oyo eyaleeta ekiwundu, n’okusigala ng’oli mwetegefu okutabagana bwe kiba kisoboka.

Naye nze mbagamba nti, Mwagalenga abalabe bammwe! Musabirenga ababayigganya! MATAYO 5:44

Abuulira emboozi eziwerako, ng’amannya gakyusiddwa, ez’abantu abaakwata ekkubo lino ne batafuna kuwonyezebwa kwabwe kwokka wabula n’enkolagana empya n’omuzadde oba omusomesa eyali abafumise. Mboozi ezikwata ku mutima, era azibuulira ng’obujulirwa bw’obulungi bwa Katonda.

Okupima enjigiriza

Omutima gw’enjigiriza eno, nti abakkiriza balina okusonyiwa okuva ku mutima nga bwe baasonyiyibwa, era nti obukyayi butusiba so ng’okusonyiwa kutusumulula, guyigirizibwa mu lwatu mu Byawandiikibwa byonna. Bangi bafunye eddembe okuyita mu yo, era ekkanisa egyetaaga mu bwangu.

Ebitundu ebimu byetaaga okwegendereza. Engeri Evans gy’ategeeramu okusiba, okusumulula n’okusonyiwa ebibi y’emu ku ngeri eziwerako abavvuunuzi abeesigwa ze bakwata; abalala ebigambo bino babitegeera ng’ebikwata ku kulangirira Enjiri n’okukangavvula mu kkanisa, so si ku bikolwa eby’okusumulula eby’omuntu ku bubwe. Emboozi ze ez’abo abaasobya emitima gyabwe ne gikyuka oluvannyuma lw’essaala ey’okusumulula bujulirwa bwa kisa kya Katonda, so si bweyamo; abamu abasonyiwa tebajja kulaba muntu mulala ng’akyuka, era okusonyiwa kwabwe tekukendeera mu mazima. Okusonyiwa tekwetaagisa muntu eyafumitibwa kuddayo eri omuntu akyali omubi eri obulamu bwe; okutabagana kwesigamye ku kwenenya ku njuyi zombi. Era ng’omuntu yayita mu bintu eby’entiisa ennyo oba mu kutulugunyizibwa, obuyambi bw’omubuulirizi ow’amagezi era atendekeddwa kirabo, so si kulemererwa kwa kukkiriza. Evans yennyini akubiriza abasomi be okufuna omubuulirizi omulungi okutambula nabo, era alabula nti si buli kijjukizo ekizuuliddwa nate nti kituufu. Ekigendererwa kye, bw’akakasa, si kunenyagana wabula eddembe.

OKUFUMIITIRIZA N’OKUKOLA

1. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu bukkakkamu akulage ekiwundu kyonna ky’ositudde okuva mu biseera eby’emabega. Toyanguyiriza; wandiika ekijja.

2. Omuntu omu bw’akujjira mu birowoozo, lowooza ku kuwandiika ebbaluwa etaweerezebwa nga Evans gy’annyonnyola. Yogera mu bulambulukufu. Wa ekiseera.

3. Bw’oneetegeka, sonyiwa buli kintu ky’owandiise, era saba mu bigambo byo ggwe Katonda aleme kuvunaana muntu oyo olw’ebibi ebyo.

4. Tandika okusabira buli lunaku omukisa gwa Katonda ku oyo eyakulumya, era weetegereze engeri gye kikyusaamu omutima gwo ggwe.

5. Ekiwundu kyo bwe kiba kiwanvu, noonya omubuulirizi oba omusumba Omukristaayo akuze era eyeesigika okutambula naawe, era tokwatibwa nsonyi kusaba.

ESSAALA
Mukama Yesu, wafumitibwa olw’okusobya kwange, era ebiwundu byo bye binwonya. Omanyi buli kiwundu kye nsitula, kubanga wali awo bwe kyabaawo.
Nkuleetera obulumi bwe naziika n’abantu abaabuleeta. Olw’ekisa kyo nsazeewo okubasonyiwa, era nkusaba obutabavunaana olw’ebintu bino.
Nsumulula okuva mu bukyayi obunsibye ku bo. Wonya emmeeme yange, zzaawo ekyamenyeka, era onjigirize okutambulira mu ddembe.
Era onfuule omuleeti w’emirembe, abalala basobole okusanga mu nze okusonyiwa kwe nnafuna mu ggwe. Amiina.

study_questions.answer: Engeri gy’ategeeramu okusiba, okusumulula n’okusonyiwa ebibi y’emu ku ngeri eziwerako, era emboozi ze ez’abaasobya abaakyuka bujulirwa so si bweyamo, kubanga abamu abasonyiwa tebajja kulaba muntu mulala ng’akyuka.
